webs.title: China leads across the board in global EV race
webs.content: Statistics from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers show that 1.71 million new energy vehicles were sold in the country in October, accounting for 51.6 percent of total vehicle sales that month. Of the NEV sales, pure EVs took the lion's share at 1.1 million units, or 33.1 percent of total vehicle sales in October, according to the CAAM. Meanwhile, smart car cabins in China are becoming increasingly intelligent, with major gains in multimodal interfaces, AI-based intent recognition and real-time command processing, according to new research from J.D. Power and Tongji University. China's position is reinforced by leading scores in both technology capability and infrastructure development, giving the country a commanding role in electric mobility and autonomous systems. Roland Berger said the gap between regions is becoming increasingly stark, particularly in areas such as software and product development speed. Chinese automakers now take just 24 to 40 months to bring new models to market, versus 48 to 60 months in Europe.

webs.content: Despite China's automotive production and sales maintaining strong growth, enhancing competitiveness and brand strength through overseas expansion and technological innovation remain key to the success of the Chinese automotive industry, experts said at the 2025 China Auto Forum. Nearly 2,000 industry experts participated in the 2025 China Auto Forum, which was held in Shanghai from July 10 to 12. Hosted by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, the forum was themed 'Enhance Quality, Embrace Innovation, and Win the Future With Intelligence.' China's auto production and sales rose 3.7 percent and 4.5 percent to 31.28 million and 31.44 million units, respectively, last year from the year before, remaining above the 30 million threshold for the second consecutive year, according to data from the CAAM. New energy vehicle production and sales surged 34 percent and 36 percent to 12.89 million and 12.87 million units, respectively, in the period. This year, NEV sales are expected to reach 16 million units, with a market share potentially exceeding 50 percent. This compares with a global average of below 20 percent. Despite the positive numbers, data from the National Bureau of Statistics showed that the average profit margin of Chinese carmakers was 4.3 percent last year and 3.9 percent in the first quarter of this year, showing eroding financial conditions. Moreover, a recent AlixPartners report indicated that among China's 129 NEV brands with sales last year, only 15 are expected to maintain financial viability by 2030. "Under the current financing conditions, automakers with a gross margin below 15 percent can no longer cover operational expenses," said Wang De'an, chief automotive industry analyst at Ping An Securities. In addition, Chinese brands still lag behind overseas competitors in brand recognition. webs.title: Explainer: Think China's NEV lead is all about subsidies? Think again
webs.content: A drone photo taken on June 17, 2025 shows new energy vehicles to be exported at the Paihe Port railway logistics base in Hefei, east China's Anhui Province. (Xinhua/Zhou Mu) BEIJING, Feb. 12 (Xinhua) -- A narrative increasingly heard in the United States and Europe attributes China's rise as the global leader in new energy vehicles (NEVs) to government subsidies. However, if this were the case, then by the end of 2022, when China's subsidies for NEV purchases have phased out, the industry should have stalled. Yet, the sector continued to grow and remained globally competitive. In 2025 alone, official data showed that China's NEV production and sales surged, reaching 16.626 million and 16.49 million units, respectively, marking year-on-year increases of 29 percent and 28.2 percent, and maintaining China's top position in the world for 11 consecutive years. So what are the drivers of China's NEV boom? This photo taken on March 6, 2025 shows an automated production site at the final assembly workshop of Chang'an Auto Digital Intelligence Factory, in Yubei District of southwest China's Chongqing. (Xinhua/Wang Quanchao) INNOVATION FUELS GROWTH Early policy support, including subsidies, indeed helped the NEV industry get off the ground in China, providing funding and stability when the market was still nascent. More importantly, such a forward-looking strategy to nurture a strategic sector and foster long-term innovation has encouraged manufacturers to invest in core technologies early and sustainably. Take NEV manufacturer BYD. The company has consistently prioritized long-term innovation over immediate profit, with R&D expenditure surpassing net income in 13 of the 14 years between 2011 and 2024. In 2025, it unveiled the Super E-Platform, designed to enable ultra-fast charging, potentially providing a 400-kilometer driving range with a five-minute charge. That same year, BYD surpassed Tesla in global electric vehicle (EV) sales.

webs.title: 2024上半年全球销量榜:中国16款车进入TOP20
webs.content: ▍中国16款进入前20,5款“黑马”横空出世 特斯拉Model Y销量虽然同比下滑5.8%,但仍以54.6万辆的碾压式优势稳坐全球新能源车销冠宝座,其兄弟Model 3销量同样出现下滑(-12.4%),被比亚迪宋PLUS反超,跌落至第三。而比亚迪宋PLUS销量同比大涨25%,达到32.5万辆,夺得亚军。 在TOP10车型榜中,比亚迪旗下车型占据7席。其中得益于荣耀版的上市,海鸥、驱逐舰05成为全球新能源车市场新晋“黑马”,秦PLUS同比上涨8.7%,稳居全球第四。 除了海鸥、驱逐舰05外,问界M7、M9和理想L7均是今年全球新能源车市场最新“黑马”。其中,得益于全新M7销量的暴涨,问界M7上半年全球销量超10万辆,首次跻身全球第八;豪华车问界M9力压BBA,大杀四方,首次跻身榜单位居第19。 同比增幅来看,除了5款新晋黑马,仅5款车同比实现上涨。其中大众ID.3、五菱缤果销量同比大涨超30%,宋PLUS销量同比上涨25%,长安Lumin销量同比上涨13.9%。 而埃安AION S、海豚、宏光MINIEV销量同比大降超30%,AION Y、元PLUS、唐、特斯拉Model 3销量同比下滑超10%。 与去年同期相比,TOP20车型榜发生巨大变化。 除了冠军宝座仍被特斯拉Model Y占据外,其余排名均发生改变。曾经位居前十的宏光MINIEV、埃安Aion S、Aion Y均跌落前十,被海鸥、驱逐舰05和问界M7取代。 后10名中,比亚迪唐、大众ID.4、ID.3、长安Lumin的排名均下滑,甚至腾势D9、沃尔沃XC40、奥迪Q4 e-tron、现代loniq 5和护卫舰07均落榜,取而代之的是海鸥、驱逐舰05、问界M7、理想L7、问界M9五款最新“黑马”的诞生。 ▍中国品牌12席进入前20,理想超越大众奔驰首次跻身前五 比亚迪以152万辆的销量成为全球最受欢迎的汽车品牌,而其最大的竞争对手特斯拉销量不增反降,上半年同比下滑6.5%,位居亚军;宝马销量同比上涨21%,稳居季军位置。

webs.title: 全球卖得最好的20款新能源车,中国占16席!这些车上榜了
webs.content: 最近,汽车销量研究机构CleanTechnica公布了2024年最新的全球新能源车销量(纯电车和插混车登记量)统计,今年3月的销量相当强劲,同比上涨了19%,达到131.4687万台。 而第一季度的新能源车的销量累计达到3216366辆,同比增长超过25%,这也让全球的新能源车渗透率上升了2%,达到16%(纯电车占10%市场份额)。 就特斯拉而言,其销量趋势并不乐观。特斯拉全系车型今年一季度销量同比下跌8%左右,总交付量上也被比亚迪拉开差距,创过去5个季度的新低。Model 3 同比下降20%。湾财社记者注意到,对于特斯拉的销量下滑,网友普遍表示,目前特斯拉产品在同价位中的性价比远低于自主品牌产品。同时,近两年公关危机导致特斯拉品牌形象有所下跌。 在如今热销的车型中,“中国队”已经成了压倒性的主力,2024年第一季度全球最好卖的20款新能源车中,中国车型占据了16款。而在Top10这个区间,含“迪”量非常惊人。 其中,比亚迪宋以14万6935台的销量排名第二,紧接着就是秦Plus,11万2222台的销量已经将特斯拉的Model3挤出了前三名。再之后是海鸥(海外也叫Dolphin Mini),7万多台的销量排行第五。

webs.title: 全球电动车月销量排名:比亚迪力压特斯拉,宝马超过问界
webs.content: 恰好近期盖世汽车整理了一张2024年2月份全球TOP20电动车品牌销量排行榜,也就是下方图表,当中呈现出来的销量格局,或许对于大家购买电动车有一定的帮助。 首先我们可以看到比亚迪和特斯拉这两个品牌的“遥遥领先”,二者单月销量都破了12万辆,比亚迪以微弱的优势实现了超越。第三名则为五菱汽车,单月销量破了3万辆,虽然夺得季军,但和二强的差距不小。 或许大家在社交媒体和短视频平台上看过这样的评论,那就是买电车的话除了特斯拉之外,也就比亚迪能买,理由是比亚迪是真正做电动车起家的,有新能源汽车全产业链优势,而其他品牌都是供应商模式,即没有自己的核心技术,都是拼装货。 以前还觉得这样的观点有些夸夸其谈,但没想到实打实的销量数据就这么摆在我们面前。随着比亚迪进军越来越多全球国家市场,其势必将在电动车领域给特斯拉带来更大的压力。 相较于冠亚季军,第四名到第十名的排名也很有意思,从前到后依次是宝马、问界、奔驰、吉利、大众、沃尔沃和理想,国产品牌仅问界、吉利和理想入局,剩下都还是传统豪强。 众所周知,在国内电动车市场,宝马、奔驰、大众和沃尔沃之流是被咱们自主品牌按在脚底下摩擦的存在,基本没有还手之力。但在全球消费者眼中,它们似乎在电动车时代还是优先选择。 在这里抛给大家一个问题,究竟是除了中国外的这些消费者不懂车,居然会买我们眼中的“杂牌”电动车,还是说咱们的消费者有眼不识金镶玉,看不到这些传统豪强生产的电动车的魅力所在,相信这一定是一个好问题。 接着往下看,第十一名到第二十名的车企,除了上汽、长安、埃安和奇瑞外,剩下的都是全球传统豪强车企。当然了,日系车在电动化赛道的落后是不争的事实,因为除了丰田勉强挤进TOP20外,诸如日产、本田、马自达等等,都没进入榜单里,日系车确实需要在电动车领域提速了。 另外,国内持续在网络上刷存在感的蔚来、小鹏、哪吒、零跑等等新势力,则无缘这张榜单。

webs.title: Global PHEV Sales Surge by 55.3% in 3Q24, BYD Market Share Exceeds 40%, Says TrendForce
webs.content: Global PHEV Sales Surge by 55.3% in 3Q24, BYD Market Share Exceeds 40%, Says TrendForce TrendForce’s latest findings show that global sales of NEVs—including BEVs, PHEVs, and FCEVs—reached 4.123 million units in 3Q24, marking a 19.3% YoY increase. Global NEV sales are projected to total 16.26 million units in 2024, representing a 24.8% YoY growth.  BEV sales in 3Q24 totaled 2.509 million units, growing 3.9% YoY. Tesla maintained its top position with an 18.5% market share, followed by BYD (brand) at 17.5%. However, for the first time, the BYD group’s sales share of BEVs among all powertrain categories within the group has fallen below 40%. The third to fifth spots in global BEV sales were occupied by SAIC-GM-Wuling, Volkswagen (brand), and GAC Aion—only SAIC-GM-Wuling achieved YoY growth. Chinese brand Leapmotor emerged as a strong contender as it secured seventh place in global BEV sales, driven by its focus on affordability and appeal to younger demographics. Additionally, Leapmotor’s joint venture with Stellantis has begun expanding into the European market. The company can leverage Stellantis’ local factories for assembly and sales expertise, which is expected to aid its market penetration in the region. Global PHEV sales in 3Q24 soared to 1.612 million units, reflecting a 55.3% YoY growth. China dominated the PHEV segment, accounting for 80% of global sales, with Chinese brands capturing several positions among the top 10. BYD (brand) remained the undisputed leader, achieving record-high sales and market, which surpassed the 40% threshold. Li Auto and AITO followed in second and third place, respectively, both reaching new quarterly sales records. However, neither brand’s market share has yet exceeded 10%. Notably, Chery made its debut in seventh place, reflecting its recent strides in NEV technology and its focus on the PHEV segment. TrendForce noted the intense competition within the Chinese market, where sales figures and market share for brands rank

webs.title: TrendForce:2024 年全球新能源车销量 1629 万辆同比年增 25%,特斯拉、比亚迪分列纯电、插混第一
webs.content: TrendForce:2024 年全球新能源车销量 1629 万辆同比年增 25%,特斯拉、比亚迪分列纯电、插混第一 IT之家 2 月 20 日消息,根据 TrendForce 集邦咨询最新统计,2024 年全球纯电动车(BEV)、插电混合式电动车(PHEV)和氢燃料电池车等新能源车合计销量达 1,629 万辆,年增 25%,其中中国市场占比扩大至 67%。预估 2025 年全球新能源车销量将年增 18%。 ▲ 图源 TrendForce IT之家从报告获悉,2024 年 BEV 销量排名中特斯拉维持第一名,比亚迪以微弱差距排第二。上汽通用五菱凭借销量年增达 44%,重返年度第三名位置。第四、五名的 Volkswagen(大众)和广汽埃安年销量皆呈负成长,第七、八名的极氪和零跑则因年销量增加近一倍,首度进入年度十大销售排行。Hyundai(现代)名次下滑至第九名,其 2024 年销量衰退 21%,在美国、韩国、欧洲等主要市场都表现不佳。 PHEV 部分,第一名的比亚迪品牌市占率约 38%,若加计集团内其他品牌则超过 40%。第二至四名分别为理想、AITO 和长安(含启源),其中,AITO 因问界 M9 带动其总销量大幅提升,进入年度市占前十大榜单。BMW 的 PHEV 销量较去年小幅下降 3%,位居第七名,其 BEV 和 PHEV 的销量差距持续扩大。

webs.title: Global EV SiC Inverter Installations Hit Record High in 3Q25, Penetration Rises to 18%, Says TrendForce
webs.content: Global EV SiC Inverter Installations Hit Record High in 3Q25, Penetration Rises to 18%, Says TrendForce TrendForce’s latest investigations indicate that total global traction inverter installations for EVs1reached 8.35 million units in 3Q25, representing a 22% increase YoY, driven by ongoing growth in the NEV2market. BEVs and PHEVs were the main contributors to this expansion, with installation increases of 36% and 13.6%, respectively. Automakers are progressively enhancing the integration of chassis electric drive systems to achieve goals for smarter and more efficient EVs. This aims to reduce wiring and hardware costs while bolstering communication efficiency and increasing driving range.  In 3Q25, over 70% of inverter installations were part of “3-in-1” or greater configurations, including components like reducers and motors. The adoption of “4-in-1” or higher integrated systems increased from 16% in the same period of 2024 to 23%. TrendForce highlights that SiC power semiconductors, due to their compact size and higher voltage capacity, are now crucial for advanced electric-drive systems. In 3Q25, worldwide SiC inverter installations reached a record high, surpassing 1.5 million units. The adoption rate in EVs rose from 14% in the same period of 2024 to 18%, and when focusing solely on NEVs, it reached 22%. A detailed analysis of vehicle models fitted with SiC inverters reveals that 84% of these installations are in BEVs, with the remainder in PHEVs and REEVs. China remains the leading market, accounting for approximately 75% of all SiC inverter installations, whereas demand in Europe and the U.S. is declining. Against a backdrop of geopolitically driven global dynamics, this structural concentration poses a risk that is difficult for IDM suppliers to mitigate or relocate. webs.title: Economic Watch: China's auto output, sales reach new highs in 2025, building global win-win ecosystem
webs.content: Economic Watch: China's auto output, sales reach new highs in 2025, building global win-win ecosystem This photo taken on May 13, 2025 shows a view of a production line at the workshop of a vehicle company in Jiangdu District of Yangzhou City, east China's Jiangsu Province. (Photo by Ren Fei/Xinhua) BEIJING, Jan. 14 (Xinhua) -- China's automobile production and sales both exceeded 34 million units last year, setting a new record high, industry data showed on Wednesday, offering new cooperation opportunities and helping to establish a global win-win ecosystem in this sector. Total auto output reached 34.531 million units last year, up 10.4 percent compared with the 2024 level, while sales rose 9.4 percent year on year to 34.4 million units, according to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM). China's auto output and sales remained first globally for 17 consecutive years, the association noted. Automobile production and sales have remained above 30 million units for three consecutive years. New energy vehicles (NEVs) accelerated their growth momentum, with production and sales totaling 16.626 million and 16.49 million units, respectively, marking respective year-on-year increases of 29 percent and 28.2 percent, and maintaining the top position in the world for 11 straight years, the CAAM confirmed. "China's automotive industry continues to demonstrate strong resilience and vitality, with multiple indicators reaching new highs, marking a successful conclusion to the 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025)," said Chen Shihua, deputy secretary general of the CAAM. In 2025, with intensified and expanded implementation of the new round of large-scale equipment upgrades and consumer goods trade-in programs, a surge in new product launches by enterprises, and sustained release of user demand, annual automobile production and sales increased more than expected, Chen said. Total auto output reached 34.531 million units last year, up 10.4 percent compared with the 2024 level, while sales rose 9.4 percent year on year to 34.4 million units, according to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM). China's auto output and sales remained first globally for 17 consecutive years, the association noted. Automobile production and sales have remained above 30 million units for three consecutive years. New energy vehicles (NEVs) accelerated their growth momentum, with production and sales totaling 16.626 million and 16.49 million units, respectively, marking respective year-on-year increases of 29 percent and 28.2 percent, and maintaining the top position in the world for 11 straight years, the CAAM confirmed. "China's automotive industry continues to demonstrate strong resilience and vitality, with multiple indicators reaching new highs, marking a successful conclusion to the 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025)," said Chen Shihua, deputy secretary general of the CAAM. In 2025, with intensified and expanded implementation of the new round of large-scale equipment upgrades and consumer goods trade-in programs, a surge in new product launches by enterprises, and sustained release of user demand, annual automobile production and sales increased more than expected, Chen said. webs.title: New models rev up sales for domestic automakers
webs.content: New models rev up sales for domestic automakers XPeng showcases the P7+ at the 2025 Auto Shanghai on April 23. (Cao Yingying/China Daily) Major carmakers in China saw an upward trajectory in April, a trend analysts say would continue with the slew of models unveiled at the Auto Shanghai to hit the market one after another in the following months. Nationwide passenger car retail sales hit 1.79 million units last month, up 17 percent year-on-year, according to the China Passenger Car Association. Of them, 52 percent were new energy vehicles, totaling 922,000 units, up 37 percent year-on-year. Automakers ranging from BYD and Geely to startups such as Leapmotor and XPeng all reported robust year-on-year growth, although their strategies to capture a bigger share in the fiercely competitive market vary. Automakers kicked off April with a remarkably active pipeline of new model releases, said Cui Dongshu, secretary-general of the CPCA. He said the continued push around the fixed-price sales strategies and zero-interest financial packages also helped boost sales. Also, many manufacturers moved quickly to capitalize on the government's vehicle replacement stimulus, rolling out factory-backed subsidies for trade-ins, and those efforts have clearly paid off. BYD, China's largest NEV manufacturer, maintained its strong growth trajectory with April sales of 380,089 units — a record for the month — up 21.3 percent year-on-year. Overseas momentum also continued to build, with 78,700 passenger cars and pickup trucks sold abroad. The Shenzhen-based group's diverse brand portfolio, including Dynasty, Ocean, Denza, Yangwang, and Fangchengbao, contributed across all segments, reinforcing its status as the leading force in the global NEV scene. BYD's Ocean series unveiled five models at the Shanghai auto show, which are hitting the market one after another. Chery Group posted total sales of 200,760 units in April, up 10.3 percent year-on-year. Its NEV sales more than doubled in April

webs.title: 全球最好卖的纯电&插混车在这里:比亚迪排第一,多款国产车上榜
webs.content: 2025年第二季度全球新能源汽车市场延续增长态势,根据TrendForce集邦咨询数据,纯电动车销量达328万辆,同比增长39%;插电混合式电动车销量158.7万辆,同比增长15%。两大细分市场竞争格局呈现显著差异,目前中国品牌在头部阵营中均占据主导地位,而新势力与传统车企的博弈也在持续深化,接下来我们就来看看销量榜前十的车企表现。 在纯电动车市场中,比亚迪以18.3%的市占率稳居全球第一,销量年增长率高达43%,其龙头地位进一步巩固,成功的背后得益于比亚迪在技术研发与市场布局的双重优势,尽管面临激烈竞争,但其王朝系列和海洋系列车型仍保持了强大的市场号召力。特斯拉虽维持第二名位置,但受中国、北美、西欧等主要市场表现衰退影响,第二季销量同比减少14%,市占率降至11.7%。 吉利以6.4%的市占率保持第三,旗下极氪品牌的高端化探索与几何系列的大众化布局形成互补,支撑其稳步增长。五菱和大众分别位列第四、第五,其中五菱宏光MINIEV家族持续贡献稳定的销量,大众ID系列虽然在国内表现一般,但在欧美市场的增长部分抵消了中国市场的下滑压力。 而在新势力品牌中,零跑和小鹏首次实现季度销量突破10万辆,分别以3.3%和3.1%的市占率位列第六、七位。零跑作为近期最强的黑马之一,凭借高性价比策略和欧洲市场布局实现快速增长,其C11、C01等车型在细分市场表现突出。小鹏则依托G6等车型在北欧市场的突破,成为首个进入当地D级SUV销量前十的中国品牌。 宝马以2.8%的市占率位居第八,其i系列车型在欧美市场保持双位数增长,但中国市场17.2%的同比下滑拖累整体表现。小米汽车作为新的黑马,以2.5%的市占率首次跻身第九,尽管目前仅依赖SU7单一车型,但其在国内连续五个月交付超2万辆,并已启动欧洲、东南亚市场布局,后续随着新车型推出和产能扩充,增长潜力值得期待。现代凭借韩国本土政策激励,销量同比增长41%,以2.4%的市占率排名第十,其IONIQ系列在欧洲市场的认可度持续提升。 插电混合式电动车市场呈现不同竞争格局,比亚迪虽仍居榜首,但市占率从近40%降至28.9%,销量同比减少12%,主要因中国品牌竞争加剧导致市场分流。理想汽车以7.4%的市占率升至第二,销量同比增长11%,其L系列车型在家庭用户市场依然拥有较强的竞争力。问界凭借6.2%的占比位列第三,鸿蒙智行生态的加持使其产品竞争力显著提升。 值得关注的是,在传统车企中,吉利银河系列、奇瑞鲲鹏C-DM技术平台车型均表现亮眼,其中奇瑞探索06 C-DM在5月销量达11125辆,同比增幅超80%,反映出技术路线多元化对市场渗透的积极作用。

webs.title: E-Weekly Highlights | "Battery King" Earns Nearly 200 Million Yuan Daily; VW and XPeng's First Joint Model Rolls Off Production Line
webs.content: CATL released its 2025 annual report on the evening of March 9. Revenue climbed to 423.7 billion yuan — a 17.04% jump from a year earlier — while net profit attributable to shareholders surged 42.28% to 72.2 billion yuan. Notably, CATL’s net profit margin hit 17%, putting daily earnings at nearly 200 million yuan. That profit figure alone likely surpasses the combined total of China’s listed automakers. By contrast, the broader auto sector saw profit margins slip to 1.8% in December 2025, with net margins potentially even lower. CATL is also generous with dividends. The proposed payout for 2025 is 6.957 yuan per 10 shares. The company has distributed half of its net profit as cash dividends for three straight years; once this year’s payout is complete, total dividends will approach 100 billion yuan. Image source: CATL annual report Net cash flow from operating activities reached 133.2 billion yuan, up 37.35%. On R&D, CATL poured 22.1 billion yuan into the business last year, steadily raising the ratio of revenue devoted to development. Over the past decade, cumulative R&D spending has topped 90 billion yuan, underpinning its lead in core technology and product innovation. CATL solidified its global dominance in 2025. Lithium battery sales jumped 39% to 661 GWh. According to SNE Research, its share of the global power battery market rose 1.2 percentage points to 39.2% — the ninth consecutive year at the top — with overseas market share climbing to 30%. To date, its power batteries have been installed in over 24 million vehicles worldwide. In the fast-growing energy storage sector, CATL also shone. Its market share for energy storage battery shipments hit 30.4% in 2025, claiming the global top spot for the fifth year running, with roughly 2,300 projects deployed worldwide.

webs.title: Yearender: Solid-State Battery's Elusive Commercialization Amid Capital Frenzy
webs.content: Solid-state batteries are moving forward amidst much buzz, transitioning from laboratory research to engineering validation, but the path to commercialization remains long and challenging. In 2025, when looking at the “heat map” of the lithium battery sector and even the global new energy industry, solid-state batteries have absolutely claimed the center stage. “Buzz” has become the most fitting keyword of the year. On one hand, as the energy density of traditional liquid batteries approaches their theoretical limits and safety concerns force a technological revolution, battery manufacturers, automakers, and even cross-industry investors are racing to break new ground. They’re all focusing on this next-generation battery technology, which is widely recognized for its potentially disruptive advantages. The list of A-share concept stocks related to solid-state batteries has already grown to 54 companies. On the other hand, from academia to industry, as well as government agencies and industry associations, news regarding breakthroughs in solid-state battery technology, sample launches, policy support, and mass production timelines keeps flooding in, continuously fueling excitement across both primary and secondary markets, as well as among consumers. Beneath all the noise, the concepts, standards, and technical paths of semi-solid and solid-state batteries are gradually being clarified. While in previous years solid-state batteries existed mostly as a concept, they are now rapidly moving towards the engineering verification phase, with the focus shifting to critical issues like “engineering feasibility” and “mass production capabilities”. However, the journey from the laboratory to engineering and ultimately to commercialization is far more challenging than most imagine. From material development to ensuring stability, then on to high costs and the need for radically new manufacturing processes and equipment, every step of the commercialization march for all

webs.title: BMW EV sales hit 1 million, plan to double BEV sales in 2022
webs.content: BMW EV sales hit 1 million, plan to double BEV sales in 2022Automaker BMW Group's electric vehicle sales have hit the 1 million mark, with the company aiming to sell around 2 million fully electric vehicles by 2025. The automaker said Dec. 7 that it planned to double battery EV sales in 2022, although did not give the expected 2021 volume. Over the January-September period, BMW sold 231,575 units of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, up 98.9% year on year, with deliveries of BEVs up 121.4% year on year at 59,688 units.

webs.title: 2025年纯电动车销量排行榜:吉利星愿夺冠,五菱第二Model Y第三
webs.content: 根据中汽数研整理和统计的《2025年纯电动汽车销量》(表格表头有误,仅参考)显示:2025年纯电动汽车销量榜前18名,年销量全部超过10万辆。榜单前十中,吉利星愿以45.95万辆的成绩领跑榜单,宏光MINI依然表现出色,全年销量达到42.7万辆,同比增长55.33%,排名第二,排名第三的是特斯拉MODEL Y(配置|询价),它卖出了38.23万辆,同比下滑20.65%,但依然是最畅销的纯电SUV之一。 榜单前十中,比亚迪占据了三款,其中海鸥排名第四,它在2025年共卖出30.7万辆,同比下滑30.9%。另外,比亚迪元UP年销量18.26万辆,同比增长38.84%,排名第七,海豚排名第九,它交出了16.05万辆、同比微增长0.01%。 进入榜单前十的纯电动车型还有小米SU7(配置|询价),它2025年卖出了25.8万辆,同比增长88.5%,榜单前十增速仅次于小鹏MONA M03(配置|询价)。特斯拉Model 3排名第六,年销量20.06万辆,同比增长13.34%,被小米SU7抢走了不少的市场份额。 小鹏MONA M03排名第八,年销量17.52万辆,同比大涨261.25%,涨幅在榜单前十中最高。小型车长安Lumin表现同样出色,年销量15.93万辆,同比增长10%,成为2025年纯电动车市场上的新黑马! 另外,吉利熊猫mini、奔腾小马等微型电动车年销量也都超过10万辆大关,全新车型小米YU7、比亚迪海狮06、海狮05等也都有不错的市场表现,元PLUS、五菱缤果、秦PLUS、银河E5、零跑C10等年销量同样超过10万辆。 合资品牌中,除了特斯拉之外,表现最出色的要属广汽丰田铂智3X了,它在2025年交出了6.92万辆的成绩单,虽然上市时间不长,但也有了月销过万的表现,相信在2026年,它凭借出色的智能辅助驾驶和一系列硬核实力,尤其是越级的性价比,将会成为合资品牌里最出色的纯电动车产品。 从2025年纯电动车市场来看,微型车、小型车和15万元以内的产品阵营依然是市场消费主体,特斯拉Model Y、小米SU7、特斯拉Model 3、小鹏P7、极氪7X、比亚迪汉蔚来ES8等也有一定的市场。合资品牌阵营中,除了特斯拉,铂智3X一枝独秀,日产N7也开始冒头,2026年铂智7等新产品也会上市,新车表现同样值得期待!

webs.title: 2025全球10大车企排名:丰田六连冠,比亚迪跃升第六,中国车企为何凶猛?+FAQ
webs.content: 2025年全球车企销量榜落定:丰田1132万辆六连冠,大众898.4万辆居亚,现代、通用、Stellantis分列三至五名。最亮眼的是比亚迪,以427万辆首次超越福特升至第六,吉利也跻身前十列第八。 01头部梯队:丰田大众“双雄”差距拉大,现代通用守住中游 2025年,丰田全球销量约1132万辆,同比增长4.6%,连续第六年蝉联全球最大汽车制造商。如果撇开日野、大发只看丰田品牌+雷克萨斯,也有1054万辆,依然稳坐头把交椅。大众集团以898.4万辆连续六年位列第二,但同比微降0.5%。一个关键变化是:丰田与大众的差距已拉大到超过230万辆——大众在中国和北美两大市场均现下滑(中国跌8%至269万辆,北美跌10.4%至94.68万辆),西欧、南美等地的增长只抵消了部分失血。 来源验证上,丰田在北美的油电混动车销量占比已接近一半,RAV4、凯美瑞(配置|询价)是绝对主力;在中国市场,丰田逆势微增0.2%至178万辆,成为日系品牌中唯一正增长者。而大众的纯电转型正在提速:全年纯电交付98.31万辆,同比大涨32%,占集团总销量的10.9%,远超上一年的8.2%。虽然整体销量承压,但电动化方向已经明确。 场景化地看,北美消费者买混动RAV4,图的是不用充电、加油就走;欧洲家庭选大众纯电车型,看重的是有固定充电桩就能实现“一周充一次”。如果只看销量规模,丰田依然是全球最“稳”的那个,但大众的电动化攻势,正在为下一个十年提前卡位。 2025年全球销量前十中最具含金量的变化来自中国车企。比亚迪以427万辆的全球销量首次超越福特,上升至全球第六,成为目前全球排名最高的中国车企。吉利控股集团超越本田、铃木、日产,排名第八。两份成绩单背后,是“出海”战略从量变到质变的兑现:比亚迪11月单月海外销量13.17万辆,同比暴涨297%;1-11月海外累计超过91万辆,是2024全年的两倍还多。 从产品力看,比亚迪的刀片电池解决了安全痛点,DM-i超级混动把亏电油耗做到3.8L/100km,直接对应了中国家庭“短途用电、长途用油”的真实场景。吉利则通过多品牌矩阵和持续的海外布局实现突破。 下面用表格直观对比中国车企的销量亮点:

webs.title: 国际市场上的电动车销量排行榜是怎样的?
webs.content: 国际市场上的电动车销量排行榜是经常变化的. 2024年 9月,特斯拉排名第一,累计销售 16.90万辆;比亚迪是亚军,纯电销量达 16.76万辆;五菱为季军,卖了 6.05万辆.大众排名第 4,卖了 3.51万辆.埃安,零跑汽车,极氪,蔚来和小鹏等新势力车企入榜前十名.宝马排名第 9,卖了 2.04万辆.吉利汽车和吉利银河分别排名第 11和第 12,销量都超 1.7万辆.小米汽车排名第 14,卖了 1.36万辆.长安福特排名第 20,卖了 1.15万辆. 2023年 8月,全球电动汽车销量同比劲增 60%至约 85万辆,纯电动车市场份额高达 11%.当月全球电动车销量排行前 15名中, 特斯拉 model y , model 3 排名第 1,3, 比亚迪宋 , 秦 plus ,海鸥,元 plus,海豚,汉分别排名第 2,4-7,9,aion y,aion s排名第 8,10,大众 id.4,id.3排名第 11,13,宏光 mini ev,五菱缤果排名第 12,14,理想 l7排名第 15. 2019年,特斯拉成为全球最大的电动车厂商,交付 36.78万辆电动车.比亚迪排名第二,销量为 22.95万辆.北汽排名第三,销量为 16万辆.上汽位列第四,广汽和东风分别排名第 15名和第 18名,江淮位列第 20名. 2023年 1-10月,比亚迪遥遥领先,销量高达 226.7万台,特斯拉排名第二.广汽埃安排名第三,销量为 40.1万台.宝马,大众排名前五.奔驰排在全球第七名. 2023上半年,出口量最高的为上汽集团,mg在全球市场销量火热,全球累计销量高达 37万辆.在海外市场,上汽在东南亚市场表现出色.特斯拉 model y 1-8月份销量达到 772364辆,model 3卖出 364403辆.埃安 s取得 160693辆的销售成绩,埃安 y取得 136619辆的销售成绩.五菱宏光 miniev达到 153399辆的销售成绩.

webs.title: 2025年全球电动车份额出炉!比亚迪14.5%反超特斯拉,动力电池六家中国企业占七成
webs.content: 比亚迪14.5%反超特斯拉,动力电池六家中国企业占七成 AI导读 比亚迪以14.5%的全球电动汽车市占率超越特斯拉,海外销量翻倍,东南亚、南美市场爆发。背后是宁德时代、比亚迪等中国电池巨头撑起的七成全球产能。但真正的挑战,是从"出口卖车"转向"本地建厂"的供应链大考。 有用 日经给出的2025年全球电动汽车整车调查里,比亚迪拿下了14.5%的市占率,把11.3%的特斯拉甩在了身后。 这是统计表格里第一次出现这种顺序颠倒。如果把不同机构的统计拉出来对比,像集邦咨询的数据,比亚迪在纯电和插混这两个细分里分别占到了15.6%和31.5%。大东时代智库那边,算的则是全球新能源总销量20.1%的份额。不管统计方法怎么变,日经这套14.5%对11.3%的数据,已经给去年的全球市场定了个调。 去年的460.2万辆总销量里,海外市场的贡献很明显。 乘用车和皮卡在海外卖了104.96万辆,同比翻了一倍多。像东南亚的泰国、印尼,还有南美的大户巴西,展厅里的走量车主力牌子已经变了。在意大利、西班牙这些欧洲国家,电动车的走量榜单顶上也出现了中国品牌的字样。 很多车友总觉得美洲那道高关税墙一砌,车子就出不去了。 真实的壁垒很复杂,2.5%的基准关税加上25%的232条款,再叠加301条款,综合下来税率能冲上137.5%。今年二月份美方最高法院对IEEPA关税有了裁定,但针对汽车的232和301条款依然在发力。可车企并没有死磕这一条通路,东南亚和南美市场的增量,直接把单点封锁的影响给消化掉了。到了五月份,美方暂停了把关税推高到100%的议案,维持在25%,这中间的政策缝隙其实一直在变动。 真正支撑这个整车份额的,是趴在底盘下面的电池供应链。 权威机构SNE Research的数据摆得很清楚,去年的全球动力电池装车量达到了1187GWh,同比增长了三成多。宁德时代拿了39.2%的份额,连续九年排在第一。比亚迪靠着自供和逐渐放开的外供,拿到了16.4%。光是这两家,就撑起了全球超过一半的电池产能。 韩系的三家电池企业,去年的总份额缩水了3.4个百分点。 包括中航锂电、亿纬锂能这些厂商在内,六家中国电池企业把全球份额吃到了70.4%。这是历史上第一次突破七成大关。做整车出口,如果底下没有这种规模的供应链撑着,海运费加上关税成本,车子运到当地展厅根本摆不出价格优势。 但如果只看纯电动这一条赛道,两家的差距其实没有想象中大。 在欧美那些成熟市场里,特斯拉依靠早期的品牌积淀,依然拿着不低的溢价能力。比亚迪现在的海运模式,接下来还要面对欧盟的反补贴调查,以及各个国家对本地化设厂的强性要求。

webs.title: Counterpoint:Q3全球最畅销电动汽车为Model Y、星愿、Model 3
webs.content: Counterpoint:Q3全球最畅销电动汽车为Model Y、星愿、Model 3 IT之家消息,今天下午,Counterpoint 咨询发布《全球电动汽车市场份额季度数据(2024 年 Q1 - 2025 年 Q3)》。IT之家从数据中获悉,2025 年 Q3 全球新能源汽车销量同比大幅增长 32%。 市场具体表现如下: 纯电动车(BEV)继续占据主导地位,占全球电动汽车销量的三分之二,其销量较去年同比增长 32%。插电式混合动力汽车(PHEV)也实现温和增长,同比增长 6%。本季度 BEV 普及率创下新高,占全球乘用车销量的 18%,高于去年同期的 14%。中国仍是全球增长的核心动力,贡献了全球 BEV 销量的 60%,其后依次为欧洲和美国。车型层面,特斯拉 Model Y、吉利 Galaxy 星愿以及特斯拉 Model 3 成为本季度全球最畅销的三款电动车。 该机构称,比亚迪、吉利控股、特斯拉是当前的全球三大 BEV 车企。 比亚迪集团在 2025 年 Q3 以近 60 万辆的 BEV 继续稳居全球市场第一,同比增长 33%。该公司在欧洲、东南亚和拉美等海外市场表现强劲,出口量超过 15 万辆,海外市场贡献率达 27%。比亚迪的核心优势在于 BEV 和 PHEV 的多样化产品布局,尤其在紧凑型 SUV 和轿车市场表现突出,通过具备竞争力的定价和规模效应保持领先。2025 年 Q3 比亚迪海鸥、海豚和元 UP 是其最畅销的三款车型。吉利控股集团以 10% 的全球 BEV 市场份额位列全球第三,2025 年 Q3 BEV 销量同比增长 51%。集团旗下银河与极氪两大品牌在中国经济型及中端电动车市场表现突出,持续推动销量增长。吉利通过“实惠定价 + 先进软件”的组合策略,在竞争激烈的中国市场持续赢得消费者青睐。旗下品牌中,吉利银河贡献了集团 BEV 总销量的一半以上。星愿、银河 E5 和几何熊猫 MINI EV 是其最畅销车型。

webs.title: Honda plans 100% zero emission vehicle sales in N. America by 2040
webs.content: Honda plans 100% zero emission vehicle sales in N. America by 2040Automaker Honda plans to reach 100% zero-emissions sales in North America by 2040, up from an expected 40% by 2030 and 80% by 2035. Honda US said late Sept. 20 that it was targeting initial sales target of 70,000 units/year for its Prologue SUV, its first new volume battery electric vehicle (BEV), due to go on sale in 2024, with BEV sales to rise to 500,000 units by 2030. Honda global CEO Toshihiro Mibe announced in April that the automaker plans to achieve carbon-neutrality for its products and corporate activities by 2050.

webs.title: SNE Research:2025年前10月全球电动汽车销量突破1710万辆
webs.content: SNE Research:2025年前10月全球电动汽车销量突破1710万辆 (来源:储能世界) 从历史数据来看,全球电动汽车市场自2017年以来保持高速增长,2017年至2024年的年复合增长率(CAGR)达到42.9%。2024年全年销量达到1766.9万辆,而2025年前10个月的销量已接近这一水平,预计全年将再创新高。 比亚迪稳居全球第一 比亚迪以332.2万辆的销量继续稳居全球电动汽车销量榜首,同比增长4.8%,全球市场份额达到19.4%。比亚迪通过在欧洲地区(匈牙利和土耳其)以及东南亚地区(泰国、印尼和柬埔寨)建设生产基地,灵活应对近期关税和补贴政策的变化。在持续提升品牌知名度的同时,比亚迪不断丰富其车型阵容,从商用车到小型车全面布局,以提升在整个电动汽车生态系统中的竞争力。 吉利集团以约178万辆的销量位居全球第二,实现了64.7%的高速增长。吉利旗下的星愿(Star Wish)车型广受欢迎,为产品线扩展做出了重要贡献。其高端品牌极氪(ZEEKR)、混动专用品牌银河(Galaxy)以及面向全球市场的领克(LYNK & CO)凭借多层次的品牌组合持续吸引消费者。吉利集团在从燃油车向电动汽车转型方面反应迅速,同时加速推进电池、电气设备和软件的自主研发,以及产能扩张。这种垂直整合和自主技术开发战略被认为是吉利核心竞争力的关键驱动因素。 特斯拉以130.8万辆的销量位居全球第三,同比下滑7.7%,市场份额从10.4%降至7.6%。Model 3和Model Y的销量从135万辆下降至127万辆是整体销量下滑的主要原因。从区域来看,特斯拉在欧洲市场销量同比下降20.5%(约21万辆),在中国市场下降8.4%(约45.9万辆),在北美市场因税收抵免政策终止也下降了8.4%(约51.6万辆)。尽管特斯拉持续推进FSD功能优化和月度订阅软件盈利模式扩展战略,但短期内显著改善销量的效果预计有限。 2025年1-10月全球电动汽车企业销量排名 (单位:千辆,数据来源:SNE Research Global EV and Battery Monthly Tracker - Nov 2025) 区域市场分析:分化加剧 中国市场:新能源渗透率首破50% 中国市场以63.7%的份额继续主导全球电动汽车市场。2025年1-10月,中国市场共销售1089.4万辆电动汽车,同比增长24.2%。值得关注的是,10月份中国新能源汽车批发销量占所有新车销量的比例达到51.6%,这是该比例首次突破50%大关,标志着新能源汽车在中国市场首次超越传统燃油车。中汽协数据显示,10月中国新能源汽车销量达到171.5万辆,创下历史新高。 尽管中国国内市场增速有所放缓,但中低价位入门级电动汽车需求持续旺盛,商用车电动化也在稳步推进。

webs.title: 特斯拉储能被中国厂商卷下神坛:跌到全球第四,毛利腰斩|产业家深度
webs.content: 特斯拉的储能业务,正在陷入危机。 2025年,一直蝉联全球第一宝座的特斯拉,被比亚迪夺去冠军。 据Benchmark Mineral Intelligence排名数据,2025年比亚迪以13%的全球市场占有率,超越特斯拉登顶全球最大电池储能系统(BESS)集成商,而同期特斯拉的市占率为10%。 2025年前10储能系统集成商市场份额 图片来源: Benchmark 而到了2026年一季度,产业研究机构InfoLink直接用“洗牌”一词定性了当下的格局。在这场牌局里,特斯拉的牌面可谓处处失守: 总出货量掉到第4,前面站着比亚迪、阳光电源和华为;曾经领跑的大储市场,现在不仅跌到了第5,甚至被中车株洲所反超;连户储市场,也被思格新能源、麦田能源和德业股份挤到了第4名。

webs.title: 崔东树:今年1-6月世界新能源汽车销量1122万台 中国占比达62%
webs.content: 来源:智通财经网其中提到,今年1-6月世界新能源乘用车达到1122万台,同比增13%,其中6月新能源车销量238万台增25%,增速回到历史正常水平。2026年1-6月的广义新能源车份额达到31.4%,其中纯电动车的占比达到16.3%,插电混动达到7.1%的汽车比例,混合动力达到8%的表现优秀。 崔东树表示,2025年中国新能源乘用车世界份额68.3%;2026年1-6月中国新能源乘用车世界份额达到62%的水平。2026年中国在世界纯电动车市场的份额是58%,在世界插电混动份额达到71%的高水平,中国在世界插电混动市场呈现超强的表现。2025年自主新能源乘用车海外市场销量份额达到15.8%,提升较大。2026年自主新能源乘用车海外市场销量份额大幅提升,6月达到26.5%,进一步大幅跃升。 2024年世界汽车销量9177万台,其中新能源汽车销量1788万台,燃油车销量占比相对下降。2025年份世界汽车销量达到9689万台,新能源汽车达到2289万台。 2026年1-6月世界汽车销量达到4786万台,新能源汽车达到1122万台。2026年1-6月普通混合动力超过插混成为增长亮点。 2025年世界广义新能源车销售比例达到世界汽车销量占比为30%,比2024年全年增长4个百分点的水平,而狭义新能源车达到了23.6%的水平,呈现相对较强的状态。 2026年1-6月的广义新能源车份额达到31.4%,其中纯电动车的占比达到16.3%,插电混动达到7.1%的汽车比例,混合动力达到8%的表现优秀。 1、世界新能源乘用车市场走势 2022-2024年世界新能源车呈现加速上升态势,低基数下的增长更强。2025年世界新能源车起步较低,随后2-9月恢复高增长。 2022-2026 年全球新能源乘用车销量的强劲增长态势:整体规模持续扩张,2025 年月度销量已突破 230 万辆,较 2022 年近乎翻倍;2026 年前6月延续高增,3-6月同比增量显著提升。 2、世界新能源乘用车表现 2020年新能源乘用车销量达到287万台,走势与2019年同期增42%。2021年新能源乘用车销量达到637万台,增长122%的超预期的超强表现。 2022年世界新能源乘用车走势较强,全年达到1039万台,同比增长63%。2023年世界新能源乘用车走势较强,全年达到1388万台,同比增长34%。 2024年世界新能源乘用车达到1788万台,同比增长29%。因为欧美新能源走势放缓,世界新能源相对前几年的走势放缓较大。2025年世界新能源车起步较低,随后2-9月恢复高增长。

webs.title: 中国汽车:打败海外巨头不难,打破 “洋迷信” 才难
webs.content: 电驹小编最近看了比亚迪王传福怒怼国内某些企业的采访:他说,国内有些人总觉得自己不行。 并直言中国在应用技术、在市场规模,都走到了全球的前面,甚至还抢美国人的市场,抢外国人的市场,可还是有人说我们在电动车技术上有很大的差距。 “明明事实摆在眼前,为何不承认?为什么一定外国的东西就好?”王传福质疑道。 和王传福这份自信截然不同的是,某些新势力高管仍在集体仰视西方。 比如理想某高管说:目前除特斯拉FSD外,国内暂未有其他智驾系统能进入全球第一梯队。理想汽车CEO李想也多次将特斯拉树为“全球智驾标杆” 小米雷军说:“特斯拉是全球纯电车的标杆”、“我们认真向特斯拉学习”。并且从SU7到YU7,小米从不讳言把特斯拉当作靶子。 2025年7月至2026年4月,小米YU7累计交付23.2万辆,而Model Y同期交付35.8万辆,总结出成绩,小米10个月对比特斯拉是“八百连胜”。对此,雷军坦言:“输给特斯拉不丢人”。 另外,还有某位车企CEO在欧洲自家的新车发布会上,直言不讳道:中国车企面对欧洲车企,还是学生。 你说在燃油车时代,我们虚心追赶、承认差距,没毛病。但新能源赛道,中国已经实现了事实上的弯道超车,技术反向输出全球。凭什么一句话抹杀整个行业十几年的突围和深耕? 那么问题来了,中国新能源车到底是洋人之下我第一,还是真真正正的世界第一? 一、技术:从追赶到反哺 我在网上经常能刷到这样的论调:如果当年不是特斯拉开放专利,中国新能源车技术不会发展这么快。 这种说法根本就是本末倒置。 首先,特斯拉2014 年开放的只是早期有限旧专利,而且国内车企主流电机、电池路线和特斯拉这套方案本身就不一样。 更关键的是,我国新能源产业布局、比亚迪等企业自研三电、动力电池企业创业,全都早于专利开放。 数据显示,2025年,比亚迪研发投入达634亿元,累计研发投入已超2500亿元。持续加码的投入催生出丰硕成果:比亚迪在全球累计申请专利超7.1万项,获得授权专利超4.2万项 7.1万项是什么概念?特斯拉的专利数量不过几千项,比亚迪是它的十几倍。 所以,比亚迪这么多专利,还需要特斯拉的专利? 这还不是全部。2025年度国家科学技术奖,比亚迪一举拿下五项二等奖,成为本届获奖项目最多的汽车行业企业。 在今年3月,比亚迪发布第二代刀片电池及闪充技术,历时6年研发,实现5分钟充电10%-70%、9分钟充至97%的全球领先能力。

webs.title: 225万辆碾压特斯拉!比亚迪凭什么成2025纯电全球销冠?3大维度拆解+FAQ
webs.content:
2025年,比亚迪纯电车型全年销量225.67万辆,以62.06万辆的绝对优势碾压特斯拉的163.61万辆,正式终结特斯拉在全球纯电市场的多年垄断,首次登顶年度销冠。这不是偶然——从2024年第四季度到2025年第四季度,比亚迪已连续5个季度纯电销量超越特斯拉,领先优势持续扩大。对于想买纯电车的用户,如果你追求核心技术自主、全球化交付能力与高性价比,比亚迪是目前最值得押注的品牌。 01销量数据全面碾压:从跟随到领跑 2025年,比亚迪纯电车型累计销售225.67万辆,同比增长27.86%;特斯拉同期交付163.61万辆,同比下降8.55%。这一降幅是特斯拉历史上最大的年度降幅,连续第二年下滑。更关键的是,比亚迪总销量达460.24万辆,蝉联全球新能源车销量冠军,海外销量首次突破100万辆,同比暴增145%。 从季度数据看,自2024年Q4至2025年Q4,比亚迪已连续5个季度纯电销量超越特斯拉,且领先幅度从最初的几万辆扩大到数十万辆。这种持续性的反超,说明比亚迪不是靠单月爆发,而是依靠体系化能力稳定输出。 场景化来看:你每天在街上看到的比亚迪纯电车(如海豚、元PLUS、汉EV)已经比Model 3/Y更常见,尤其是在一二线城市,比亚迪的充电桩覆盖率与售后网点密度也在同步跟进。对于普通家庭用户,这意味着更低的补能焦虑和更方便的维保体验。 以下是比亚迪与特斯拉2025年核心销量数据对比:
指标比亚迪特斯拉
全年纯电销量225.67万辆163.61万辆
同比增速+27.86%-8.55%
总销量(含混动)460.24万辆165.47万辆(生产)
海外销量105万辆(首次破百万)主要靠本土+欧洲
研发投入634亿元(A股第一)约250亿元(估算)
“但是”需要注意的是:比亚迪的纯电销量虽然超越特斯拉,但在高端车型(如Model S/X/ Cybertruck)和自动驾驶软件收入方面,特斯拉仍占优势。不过对于大众市场用户,比亚迪的产品线覆盖更广(从7万到30万价位),日常使用场景更丰富。 02技术研发构筑护城河:刀片电池与闪充解决续航焦虑 比亚迪能实现销量反超,核心驱动力是长达20年的技术积累。2025年公司研发投入达634亿元,连续两年位居A股上市公司第一,累计研发投入已突破2500亿元。这些钱转化为了两项关键成果: 第一,第二代刀片电池。2026年3月发布,能量密度提升的同时,安全性通过4倍新国标热扩散试验——简

webs.title: BYD overtakes Tesla in 2025 EV sales
webs.content: China's leading new energy vehicle manufacturer BYD sold around 2.26 million electric vehicles (EVs) in 2025, surpassing Tesla in global EV sales last year. U.S. electric automaker Tesla delivered about 1.63 million EVs in 2025, according to company data. Last year, BYD sold roughly 4.6 million new energy vehicles (NEVs). BYD said it has expanded its market in China, while also increasing its overseas sales. Its European business has been robust, and the company is exploring markets in Latin America and Southeast Asia. Notably, BYD is stepping up its local production efforts. The firm's factory in Brazil started operation last year. BYD's overseas sales exceeded 1.04 million in 2025, including passenger cars and pickup trucks, covering over 110 countries and regions, thereby making it one of the fastest-growing Chinese automakers in terms of exports. In December last year, BYD said it would strengthen its technological edge in the coming years. "BYD has, on one hand, consolidated its price competitiveness through scale production, and on the other, boosted its global sales through targeted sales strategies," noted Zhou Fatao, secretary general of the Guangdong New Energy Vehicles Industry Association. Zhou attributed this uptick in overseas sales to models including ethanol hybrids in Brazil, which cater to the reality of Brazil as a major ethanol fuel market, high-range models valued by European buyers and cost-effective right-hand-drive cars that are popular in Thailand. "BYD's sales and market performance shows that Chinese automakers have attained leapfrog development and are becoming leaders in the global new energy vehicle sector," he said.

webs.title: Power play: Evaluating the U.S. position in the global electric vehicle transition
webs.content: Similarly, of the automakers' announcements that sum to 22 million annual electric vehicle sales by 2025, about 2.3 million (or about 10%) are slated to be manufactured in the United States. Seven of the 44 major U.S. assembly plants, representing about 16% of U.S. vehicle production and capacity, will manufacture only electric vehicles in 2025. The U.S. electric plants include three owned by General Motors, two by Tesla, and one each by emerging electric vehicle companies Rivian and Lucid Motors. Five automakers (Ford, Fiat Chrysler, Toyota, Honda, and Nissan) that each produce about 900,000 to 1.5 million vehicles annually have not announced plans for electric vehicle-only assembly plants. Based on this assessment, more investigation is needed to identify and recommend targeted electric vehicle policy actions to bolster the U.S. auto industry. With 44 major manufacturing plants and production volume of more than 10 million light-duty vehicles, the United States has both a risk of continuing to lag developments in China and Europe and also an opportunity to increase its share of global electric vehicle production.

webs.title: Chinese automakers overtake Japanese counterparts to lead global sales for 1st time: media
webs.content: A worker assembles a new energy vehicle at the workshop of Chinese Automaker Chery in Shijiazhuang, north China's Hebei Province, Jan. 8, 2026. (Photo by Liang Zidong/Xinhua) TOKYO, March 23 (Xinhua) -- Chinese automakers have surpassed their Japanese counterparts in global vehicle sales for the first time, marking a significant shift in the global automotive industry, according to a recent report by Nikkei. The report said that total global sales by Japanese automakers fell slightly to around 25 million units in 2025, causing Japan to lose its long-held top position for the first time since 2000. Meanwhile, Chinese car manufacturers recorded nearly 27 million units in global sales last year, rising to the top spot worldwide. The conclusion was based on data released by major automakers and research conducted by automotive data platform MarkLines, Nikkei said. Among individual companies, BYD surpassed Ford to rank sixth globally in 2025, while Geely overtook Honda to secure the eighth place, the report said. Six Chinese automakers entered the global top 20 rankings, including Chery, Changan Automobile, SAIC Motor, and Great Wall Motors, outnumbering Japan's five. In the electric vehicle segment, BYD also exceeded Tesla to become the world's leading EV seller, it added. Tang Jin, a senior researcher at Japan's Mizuho Bank and an expert in the automotive sector, noted that China's rise to the top is more than a simple change in rankings. It signals a restructuring of the global automotive landscape, driven by China's strengths in advanced technology, cost efficiency, and rapid research and development. He added that Japan needs to reassess its strategies in vehicle electrification and global market positioning in response to the evolving competition.■

webs.title: More Chinese automakers hit top global sales ranks
webs.content: More Chinese automakers hit top global sales ranks Chinese automakers have overtaken Japanese peers in global sales for the first time in decades. The companies sold about 27 million new vehicles worldwide last year, up around 10 percent year-on-year, according to a recent news report by Nikkei, citing data from Japanese market research firm MarkLines. In comparison, Japanese automakers saw a slight decline, with total sales falling to some 25 million units. The development marks the first time since 2000 that Japan's auto industry has lost its position as the world's top seller. At the company level, Toyota Motor retained its global lead with sales of 11.32 million units, with Chinese automakers making notable gains overall. BYD surpassed Ford to rank sixth globally in 2025, while Geely Auto overtook Honda to place eighth. Six Chinese automakers — BYD, Geely, Chery, Changan, SAIC Motor and Great Wall Motor — were among the world's top 20 automakers by sales, compared with five from Japan. Zhang Hong, a senior new energy vehicle industry expert at the China Automobile Dealers Association, said the collective rise of Chinese automakers is reshaping the competitive landscape. "The fact that the number of Chinese automakers among the global top 20 has exceeded that of Japan marks a shift from the long-standing 'US-Japan rivalry' to a more diversified competition involving China, the US, Europe and South Korea," Zhang said. In China, the world's largest auto market, total vehicle sales reached 34.4 million units in 2025, data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers show. Against this backdrop, major Japanese automakers saw a sharp decline in China. Combined sales of Toyota, Nissan and Honda totaled about 3.08 million units in China, with their market share falling below 9 percent, down from more than 20 percent at their peak. Among the three, Toyota was the only Japanese brand to post growth in the market, with sales reaching 1.78 million units in 2025,

webs.title: Geely Auto Exceeds 3.02 Million Vehicle Sales in 2025, Sets New Growth Targets for 2026
webs.content: Geely Auto Exceeds 3.02 Million Vehicle Sales in 2025, Sets New Growth Targets for 2026 January 5th, 2026 — Geely Automobile Holdings Limited (0175.HK) announced its full-year sales results for 2025. Total vehicle sales reached 3,024,567 units , representing a 39% year-on-year increase and a new all-time high. The result exceeded the revised annual target of 3 million units set earlier in the year. Geely Auto New Energy Lineup (named Geely Yinhe in Chinese market) recorded annual sales of 1.24 million units , successfully achieving its “Million Units” milestone. Lynk & Co surpassed 350,000 units , also setting a new historical record, while ZEEKR posted monthly sales of more than 30,000 units in December , the highest in its history. As of the end of 2025, Geely Auto’s cumulative vehicle sales have exceeded 20 million units . New energy vehicle (NEV) sales accelerated sharply , reaching 1,687,767 units , up 90% year on year , marking another record high and fully meeting the company’s annual NEV sales target. In the internal combustion engine (ICE) segment, Geely Auto continued to demonstrate strong resilience and leadership. Geely Auto ICE Lineup (Named China Star in Chinese market) achieved cumulative sales of 1,214,132 units in 2025, delivering 3% growth despite overall market pressure and surpassing its one million sales target. In 2025, Geely Auto further advanced the implementation of the Taizhou Declaration . Under the strategic coordination of “One Geely”, the company achieved major breakthroughs across new energy vehicles, full-domain AI empowerment, and high-quality global localization - continuing to drive the upward development of Chinese automotive brands. Looking ahead to 2026, Geely Auto has set a total sales target of 3.45 million units , including 2.22 million NEVs . webs.title: Counterpoint:Q3全球最畅销电动汽车为Model Y、星愿、Model 3
webs.content: IT之家从数据中获悉,2025 年 Q3 全球新能源汽车销量同比大幅增长 32%。 纯电动车(BEV)继续占据主导地位,占全球电动汽车销量的三分之二,其销量较去年同比增长 32%。插电式混合动力汽车(PHEV)也实现温和增长,同比增长 6%。本季度 BEV 普及率创下新高,占全球乘用车销量的 18%,高于去年同期的 14%。中国仍是全球增长的核心动力,贡献了全球 BEV 销量的 60%,其后依次为欧洲和美国。该公司在欧洲、东南亚和拉美等海外市场表现强劲,出口量超过 15 万辆,海外市场贡献率达 27%。比亚迪的核心优势在于 BEV 和 PHEV 的多样化产品布局,尤其在紧凑型 SUV 和轿车市场表现突出,通过具备竞争力的定价和规模效应保持领先。2025 年 Q3 比亚迪海鸥、海豚和元 UP 是其最畅销的三款车型。吉利控股集团以 10% 的全球 BEV 市场份额位列全球第三,2025 年 Q3 BEV 销量同比增长 51%。集团旗下银河与极氪两大品牌在中国经济型及中端电动车市场表现突出,持续推动销量增长。吉利通过“实惠定价 + 先进软件”的组合策略,在竞争激烈的中国市场持续赢得消费者青睐。旗下品牌中,吉利银河贡献了集团 BEV 总销量的一半以上。星愿、银河 E5 和几何熊猫 MINI EV 是其最畅销车型。特斯拉以超过 13% 的全球份额排名第二,2025 年 Q3 销量同比增长 7%。今年特斯拉销量提升主要受益于改款 Model Y 的强劲表现,以及在中国推出的长轴距版 Model Y。此外,由于美国消费者赶在 2025 年 10 月 EV 税收抵免取消前抢购,推动特斯拉在美国市场的销量增长。

webs.title: China maintains lead in EV push, IEA report says, highlighting nation’s vital role in global green development
webs.content: This photo taken on April 24, 2024 shows a new energy vehicle (NEV) assembly line of BYD, China's leading NEV manufacturer, at the plant of BYD in Zhengzhou, central China's Henan Province. (Photo/Xinhua) Global electric car sales exceeded 17 million units in 2024, reaching a share of more than 20 percent of total vehicle sales, while electric vehicle (EV) sales continued to break records globally, particularly in China and other emerging economies, according to a report from the International Energy Agency (IEA) released on Wednesday. The additional 3.5 million EVs sold in 2024 compared with the previous year represented more than the total number of those sold worldwide in 2020. China maintained its lead, per the Global EV Outlook 2025 of the IEA. "The more than 11 million electric cars sold in China last year were more than global sales just two years earlier," the report said. More than one in four cars sold worldwide in 2025 is set to be electric, as EV sales continue to grow, the report predicted. Emerging markets in Asia and Latin America are becoming new centers of growth, with EV sales jumping by more than 60 percent in 2024. Policy support and relatively affordable EV imports from China played a "central role" in increasing sales in some emerging EV markets, the report noted. Notably, the report predicted that the deployment of EVs across all vehicle modes will replace the use of more than 5 million barrels of oil per day globally in 2030, an important energy security consideration. Half of these savings are the result of EV adoption in China. Despite uncertainties in the outlook, the share of electric cars in overall car sales is set to exceed 40 percent in 2030 under today's policy settings and China is poised to continue leading in electric car sales to 2030, achieving a share of about 80 percent on the back of significant market momentum and competitively priced EVs. webs.title: 热点研究丨IEA发布《全球电动汽车展望2025》:谁在领跑?谁在观望?
webs.content: 谁在观望? 5月14日,国际能源署(IEA)发布了《全球电动汽车展望2025》报告(Global EV Outlook 2025)。从整车销量到充电基础设施,从电池供需到政策博弈,这份报告勾勒出全球电动汽车产业的最新走向。CCTP对报告重点内容进行了翻译与整理,帮助您迅速掌握全球电动汽车发展的最新态势与展望。 —Global EV Outlook 2025— 全球销量再创新高,新兴市场成为新动能 2024年,全球电动汽车销量首次突破1,700万辆,同比增长超过25%,全球新车市场中有超过五分之一为电动车型。预计2025年全球电动车销量将突破2,000万辆,占比达到25%。其中,中国继续稳居全球最大市场,全年销量超过1,100万辆,占据全球总销量的三分之二。 图1 2014-2024年全球电动汽车销量 新兴市场的表现尤为亮眼。东南亚和拉丁美洲的电动车销量同比增长超过60%,泰国、越南和巴西成为领跑国家。IEA指出,中国电动车的出口在这些国家销量增长中起到关键作用:在巴西和泰国,中国品牌电动车的市场占有率分别达到85%和75%以上。相比之下,欧洲销量与去年持平,美国虽有增长但趋势放缓,部分市场对电动车的价格与基础设施仍存顾虑。 报告预测,在当前政策基础上,到2030年全球电动车保有量将是现在的四倍。但报告中也强调,全球经济波动、能源价格走向、贸易政策不确定性等因素可能对这一进程产生影响。 制造与贸易格局重塑,中国主导地位进一步强化 伴随市场增长,电动汽车制造与出口的格局也在快速演变。2024年全球电动汽车共生产1,730万辆,比2023年增加约四分之一。中国仍然是世界电动汽车制造中心,2024年占全球产量的70%以上,继续在整车制造和供应链控制方面保持显著优势。 出口方面,全球电动汽车贸易量达到320万辆,同比增长20%。中国以近125万辆的出口量,占全球出口总量的40%,稳居第一。欧盟仍是净出口地区,但产量增长放缓;美国则延续净进口格局,2024年进口增长近40%,而出口下降了近15%。面对贸易壁垒和本地制造要求,中国车企正加快海外建厂步伐,逐步实现“出口产品”向“出口产能”的转变。 中国加强重型电动汽车领先地位,电动卡车TCO优势渐显 在经济复苏、“以旧换新计划”、电池价格下跌和更严格排放标准引入的背景下,中国推动了全球重型电动汽车的销量增加。2024年,全球电动客车销量达到7万多辆,同比增长30%;全球电动中型和重型卡车的销量超9万辆,同比增长近80%。其中,中国电动客车销量占全年总销量的近70%,电动卡车销量占全年总销量的80%以上。 制造与贸易格局重塑,中国主导地位进一步强化

webs.title: 国际能源署发布《2025年全球电动汽车展望》报告
webs.content: 国际能源署发布《2025年全球电动汽车展望》报告 5月14日,国际能源署(IEA)发布题为《2025年全球电动汽车展望》(Global EV Outlook 2025)的报告,评估了全球电动汽车的最新发展趋势。报告指出,2024年,全球电动汽车销量超过1700万辆,在全球汽车市场的份额首次超过1/5。尽管存在诸多不确定性,但到2030年,全球电动汽车的市场份额预计将超过40%。报告的主要结论如下: (1)全球电动汽车销量持续打破纪录,尤其是在中国和其他新兴经济体。①2024年,全球电动汽车销量超过1700万辆,销售份额超过20%。其中,中国电动汽车销量超过1100万辆。②亚洲和拉丁美洲的新兴市场正逐渐成为新的增长中心。2024年,这些地区的电动汽车销量增长超60%,达到近60万辆,相当于5年前欧洲市场的规模。 (2)预计中国和欧洲将引领电动汽车销量的增长,其他新兴经济体的电动汽车销量也将大幅增加。①2025年,预计全球电动汽车销量将超过2000万辆,占全球汽车总销量的1/4以上。其中,中国电动汽车销量预计将占其汽车总销量的60%左右。②尽管存在不确定性,但在目前的政策环境下,到2030年,全球电动汽车在汽车总销量中的份额将超过40%。③贸易和产业政策演变的不确定性、经济下行风险以及油价下跌可能会影响电动汽车的普及,同时也会影响整个汽车市场。 (3)随着制造商瞄准新兴市场,全球电动汽车贸易持续增长。①中国仍然是全球电动汽车制造中心,占全球产量的70%以上。②2024年,全球电动汽车贸易增长20%,目前进口量占全球电动汽车销量的近1/5。③随着中国汽车制造商在巴西、墨西哥和东南亚取得销售突破,中国电动汽车出口市场正逐渐多样化。 (4)竞争和电池价格下降逐渐提高电动汽车的可负担性。

webs.title: IEA Bullish on Global EV Outlook
webs.content: Electric car sales could hit 17 million this year compared to 14 million in 2023, accounting for more than one in fi ve cars sold globally, theInternational Energy Agency (IEA) says. Ten million electric vehicles (EVs) alone are expected to be sold in China , where the market share of electric cars could reach up to 45% thisyear, the IEA forecast in its latest Global EV Outlook . "Rather than tapering off, the global EV revolution appears to be gearing up for a new phase of growth," IEA Executive Director Fatih Birolsaid. Sales in the fi rst quarter of 2024 climbed by 25% compared with the same period last year. EV sales soared by 35% year on year in 2023. Despite near-term headwinds in some markets, the report projects that, based on today's energy, climate and industrial policy settings,every other car sold globally in 2035 will be electric.

Ten million electric vehicles (EVs) alone are expected to be sold in China , where the market share of electric cars could reach up to 45% thisyear, the IEA forecast in its latest Global EV Outlook . "Rather than tapering off, the global EV revolution appears to be gearing up for a new phase of growth," IEA Executive Director Fatih Birolsaid. Sales in the fi rst quarter of 2024 climbed by 25% compared with the same period last year. EV sales soared by 35% year on year in 2023. Despite near-term headwinds in some markets, the report projects that, based on today's energy, climate and industrial policy settings,every other car sold globally in 2035 will be electric.

webs.title: Chinese automakers speed up integration into global market
webs.content: This photo taken on Nov. 3, 2025 shows a new energy vehicle (NEV) assembly line of BYD, China's leading NEV manufacturer, at the plant of BYD in Zhengzhou, central China's Henan Province. (Photo courtesy of Xinhua) Chinese auto enterprises continued to expand overseas in 2025, while actively integrating into local supply and production chains in the new year, with BYD, China's leading new-energy vehicle (NEV) manufacturer, serving as the latest example, as the company reportedly became the fastest-growing Chinese brand in Ecuador last year with its pure electric cars. In 2025, BYD sold 2,916 vehicles, up 243.1 percent year-on-year, in the South American country, Ecuadorian media outlet El Universo reported on Wednesday (local time), citing figures from the Association of Automotive Companies of Ecuador. According to the association, GWM, Chery, Dongfeng, Sinotruk and Foton were among the top 20 in vehicle sales for 2025 in the nation, the report said. Bloomberg reported on Tuesday that BYD outsold Tesla in Europe's two largest electric vehicle (EV) markets last year. In Germany, Europe's biggest EV market, the Chinese company's car sales surged eightfold to 23,306, while Tesla's fell by nearly half to 19,390. BYD also outperformed Tesla in the UK. In 2025, BYD's overseas sales reached 1.049 million units, up 145 percent year-on-year. In December alone, sales hit 132,000 units, demonstrating strong momentum in overseas sales, according to a report BYD sent to the Global Times on Thursday. The company has also actively built factories overseas to better meet local market demand. "The factories that have been completed are in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Brazil, while those under construction are in Hungary and Cambodia," BYD told the Global Times. In addition to BYD, other Chinese auto brands have moved to integrate into overseas supply and production chains in the new year.

webs.content: 根据TrendForce集邦咨询最新调查,2025年第二季全球纯电动车(BEV)、插电混合式电动车(PHEV)和氢燃料电池车等新能源车(NEV)新车销量达486.8万辆,年增30%。若计入油电混合车(HEV),第二季电动车(EV)销量更达到645.6万辆,占全球汽车总销量29%。 ⑴ 纯电车(BEV)销量达328万辆,年成长39% BYD(比亚迪)以18.3%的市占率稳居BEV最大品牌,销量年增率高达43%。Tesla(特斯拉)虽维持市占第二名,但在中国、北美、西欧等市场表现衰退,即便于韩国、挪威和土耳其有所成长,也难以弥补主要市场的下滑幅度,导致第二季整体销量年减约14%。 Geely(吉利)保持市占第三名,占比约6.4%。第六、七名的Leapmotor(零跑)和XPeng(小鹏)则首度达成季销售10万辆以上,尤其Leapmotor的成长速度惊人。 ⑵ 插电混合式电动车(PHEV)销量为158.7万辆,年增15% BYD虽在PHEV市场保持领先,但激烈竞争造成其第二季销量年减12%,市占率因此由先前的近40%下降至28.9%,BYD失去的市场正被其他中国品牌瓜分。第二名的Li Auto(理想)得益于销量年增11%,第二季市占率微幅上升至7.4%,AITO(问界)的占比更成长至6.2%,位居第三。

webs.title: BYD overtakes Tesla in 2025 to become world's biggest battery-electric car s...
webs.content: China's BYD overtook Tesla in global electric-vehicle sales in 2025 for the first time, company disclosures showed, marking a shift in leadership in the fast-growing EV market. On a battery-electric basis, BYD said its BEV sales rose 27.86% last year to 2.257 million units worldwide. Tesla delivered 1.636 million vehicles, down 8.6% from a year earlier, extending its decline for a second consecutive year. Including plug-in hybrids, BYD's total new energy vehicle (NEV) sales reached 4.602 million units globally in 2025, up 7.73% year on year, underscoring its scale advantage across multiple powertrain segments. In late December, BYD rolled off its 15 millionth new energy vehicle, the Denza N8L. The company said it took 17 years to produce its first 10 million NEVs, but only 13 months to add the next 5 million, highlighting the speed at which China's auto industry has expanded. BYD's growth has been underpinned by heavy investment in engineering and technology. The company employs about 120,000 engineers and spent 43.75 billion yuan on research and development in the first three quarters of 2025, up 31% from a year earlier. Cumulative R&D spending has exceeded 220 billion yuan. The reversal is notable given remarks by Tesla chief executive Elon Musk in 2011 that he did not see BYD as a competitor. When the clip resurfaced in 2023, Musk said the comments were outdated and acknowledged that BYD's vehicles had become highly competitive. Tesla's weaker showing had been widely anticipated. The company earlier published a compilation of analysts' expectations indicating that 20 institutions forecast a 15% year-on-year drop in fourth-quarter deliveries and full-year sales of about 1.64 million vehicles. While Tesla said it did not endorse those forecasts, its final numbers came in below expectations. The US carmaker has faced mounting pressure from policy shifts and intensifying competition. webs.title: 2025 Global Automotive Consumer Research Report (France Edition)
webs.content: 2025 France Automotive Consumption Report: Electric Vehicles Encountering Cooling, Local Brands Losing Ground, Consumers Prefer 'Their Own Cars' Recently, Deloitte released the '2025 Global Automotive Consumer Research Report (France Edition)', based on a survey of 1,014 consumers in France, revealing key trends in the local automotive market: the popularization of Battery Electric Vehicles (BEV) is facing obstacles, fuel vehicles and hybrid vehicles still dominate; consumers' obsession with vehicle ownership far exceeds that of neighboring European countries, and the acceptance of shared mobility is low; local automotive brands are losing appeal, while foreign brands are more favored. Behind these trends, the combination of price sensitivity, usage anxiety, and consumption habits is reshaping the landscape of the French automotive market. Electric Vehicles Get Praise but Not Sales, Price and Range Are the Biggest Barriers Despite the ongoing rise of environmental issues, French consumers' enthusiasm for electric vehicles remains difficult to ignite. Data shows that by 2025, only 9% of French consumers plan to purchase pure electric vehicles (BEV), a figure that is not only far lower than that for fuel vehicles (44%) and regular hybrid vehicles (21%), but has also not seen significant growth compared to 2023. In contrast, other European countries, while also showing low intent to purchase electric vehicles, have less pronounced 'electric vehicle apathy' compared to France. webs.title: 'Growing EV adoption forcing oil & gas companies diversify revenue streams'
webs.content: Global battery electric vehicle (BEV) sales rose 13% annually in 2024 to reach 10.4-mn, accounting for 14% of new personal vehicle sales worldwide, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). As many regions leverage state support to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and reduce dependence on fossil fuels, oil and gas companies are facing growing pressure to diversify into EV-related energy solutions, including charging infrastructure and battery technologies, says market research firm GlobalData.

webs.title: 中国癌症面临哪些负担?GLOBOCAN 2024与国家癌症中心统计数据揭示这些关键变化 | 今日前沿
webs.content: GLOBOCAN 2024与国家癌症中心统计数据揭示这些关键变化 | 今日前沿 癌症是全球重大公共卫生挑战,准确把握疾病负担的规模与结构,是科学制定防控策略的前提。近日,国际癌症研究机构(IARC)在 CA: A Cancer Journal for Clinicians 发布GLOBOCAN 2024全球癌症统计报告,国家癌症中心郑荣寿等团队前期也更新了关于2024年中国癌症发病与死亡估计的统计数据。两份报告分别从全球和中国视角出发,系统呈现了当前癌症流行的最新图景。 本文特别梳理两份报告核心数据,重点对标中国与全球在癌种结构、性别年龄特征及长期趋势方面的异同,以期为肿瘤领域临床与公卫工作者提供一份兼具国际视野与中国语境的参考。 全球癌症负担总览 2064万新发,976万死亡 根据国际癌症研究机构(IARC)发布的GLOBOCAN 2024估计数据,2024年全球估计新发癌症病例约2064万例(不含非黑色素瘤皮肤癌约为1950万例),癌症死亡约976万例(不含非黑色素瘤皮肤癌约为970万例)。这意味着,全球约每5人中就有1人一生中可能罹患癌症,每9名男性和每13名女性中各有1人可能死于癌症(GLOBOCAN 2024,Table 1)。 从地理分布来看,亚洲承载了全球50.7%的新发病例和56.5%的癌症死亡,而其人口占全球的58.8%;欧洲以9.2%的全球人口贡献了21.0%的新发病例和20.0%的死亡,疾病负担相对偏高。非洲和亚洲的死亡负担占比较发病占比更高,反映了这些地区癌症总体生存率偏低、医疗资源可及性不足的现实(GLOBOCAN 2024,Figure 2)。 全球年龄标化发病率(ASIR)男性为209.6/10万,女性为185.8/10万,男性高出约13%;但年龄标化死亡率(ASMR)男性为106.2/10万,女性为72.8/10万,性别差异达46%,远大于发病率的性别差异(GLOBOCAN 2024,Table 2)。 中国癌症负担总览 515万新发,258万死亡 根据中国国家癌症中心郑荣寿等发表于Journal of the National Cancer Center的最新估计,2024年中国估计新发癌症病例约515.06万例,粗发病率为366.57/10万,按Segi世界标准人口标化的ASIR为207.7/10万;癌症死亡约258.22万例,粗死亡率为183.78/10万,ASMR为90.90/10万(NCC 2024,Table 1-2)。 该估计基于全国919个合格的肿瘤登记点2019年数据,其中106个登记点提供了2010-2019年连续监测数据用于趋势建模,覆盖约44.89%的全国人口。研究采用贝叶斯年龄-时期-队列模型对2024年发病率和死亡率进行预测,方法与2022年估计一致,保证了可比性。

webs.title: 产业观察|全球电车(EV)市场展望和趋势报告【走出去智库】
webs.content: 随着全球气候变化和环境保护意识的日益增强,电动汽车(EV)作为绿色出行的重要选择,正逐步成为全球汽车市场的主力军。国际能源署(IEA)发布的报告《2024年全球电动汽车展望》预计,2024年全球电动车总销量达到1700万辆,全球的车辆销售中超过五分一为电动车。 走出去智库(CGGT)观察到,中国已经成为全球电动汽车市场的领先者,2023年全球电动汽车的销售中超过半数来自于中国的车厂,以此为基础中国在2023年成为了全球最大的汽车出口国。但随着美国、欧盟在2024年对中国电动汽车加征关税,将会对中国电动汽车出口造成一定的压力和影响。 全球电车市场发展趋势如何?今天,走出去智库(CGGT)刊发一篇全球电车报告重点内容的文章,供关注全球电车产业发展的读者参阅。 要点 1、中国、欧洲和美国也占汽车总销量和保有量的三分之二左右,这意味着这些市场的电车转型对全球趋势有重大影响。 2、2023 年,中国以外的新兴市场和发展中经济体 (EMDE) 的电车销量继续增长,但总体仍处于较低水平。 3、预计 2024 年电车销量将比 2023 年增加 300 万辆,其中大部分来自中国。 正文 Trends in electric cars(EV) 在过去的 2-3 年里,业界一致认为电车(electric cars)正在快速发展。 2023 年电车销量接近 1400 万辆,其中 95% 在中国、欧洲和美国。 2023 年全球注册的电车保有量将达到4000 万辆,与2023 年版《全球电车展望》(GEVO-2023)的销售预测非常接近。2023年的电车销量比 2022 年高出 350 万辆,同比增长 35%。这比仅仅5 年前的 2018 年高出六倍多。2023 年,每周有超过 25 万辆新注册,超过了 10 年前 2013 年的全年总数。2023 年,电车占所有汽车销量的 18% 左右,高于 2022 年的 14% 和 5 年前的2018 年的 2%。这些趋势表明,随着电车市场的成熟,增长依然强劲。2023 年,电池电车占电车保有量的 70%。 虽然电车的全球销量正在增长,但仍然主要集中在少数几个主要市场。2023年,近 60% 的新电车注册来自中国,近25% 在欧洲,美国为 10%——相当于全球电车销量的近 95%。在这些国家,电车占据了当地汽车市场的很大份额:2023年,中国新车注册量中超过三分之一是电车,欧洲超过五分之一是电车,美国十分之一是电车。然而,其他地方的销量仍然有限,即使是在汽车市场发达的国家,如日本和印度。由于销售集中,全球电车保有量也日益集中。尽管如此,中国、欧洲和美国也占汽车总销量和保有量的三分之二左右,这意味着

webs.title: 全球份额调查:中国企业19个品类居首,宁德时代、比亚迪表现亮眼
webs.content: 7月30日,财闻海外资讯消息,《日本经济新闻》对主要产品和服务2025年的全球市场份额进行了调查。结果显示,中国企业在车载电池等相当于4成的25个品类扩大了市场份额。中国企业以东南亚等地为中心扩大销售,这也凸显出美国关税政策的实际效果有限。 此次针对全球经济活动中67种重要的最终产品和服务,调查了各行业前五家企业的市场份额。从全球份额居首的品类数来看,美国为23个(上年为27个),中国为19个(上年18个),日本则有10个品类。 中国企业有37个品类进入全球前五,占其中7成的25个品类实现了市场份额增长,份额扩大的品类数量超过了2024年的24个。 从车载锂离子电池来看,宁德时代新能源科技(CATL)同比提高4.2个百分点,达40.8%,位居第一。中国企业整体份额较2024年扩大5.4个百分点,达到57.8%。 从纯电动汽车(EV)来看,比亚迪以14.5%的份额反超美国特斯拉(11.3%),跃居首位。中国车企加强攻势的是东南亚市场。在泰国, 比亚迪等中国企业的份额已超过2成。 在中国企业提高存在感的同时,美国企业则在26个品类中出现份额下滑,其中路由器和服务器的份额下降尤为明显。

webs.title: 2025年全球电动汽车展望
webs.content: 核心数据与市场分析 全球电动汽车市场正以前所未有的速度扩张,销量持续刷新纪录。 2024年全球电动汽车销量突破1700万辆,同比增长约25%,首次占全球汽车市场份额的20%以上。报告预计,2025年全球电动汽车销量将突破2000万辆,占全球汽车总销量的四分之一以上。在当前政策环境下,预计到2030年,电动汽车将占全球汽车销量的40%以上。 分区域看,中国持续领跑全球市场,2024年电动汽车销量占国内新车销量近五成,占全球销量的三分之二以上。欧洲市场销量在2024年趋于平稳,市场份额保持在20%左右,预计2025年将提升至25%。美国市场保持稳健发展,电动汽车占总销量比例约10%。亚洲和拉丁美洲等新兴市场成为新的增长中心,2024年总销量同比增长超过60%,其中东南亚市场渗透率达9%,巴西市场渗透率突破6%。

webs.title: 4月全球新能源汽车市场分析
webs.content: 4 月插电式车型占比达 22%,销量 150 万辆 2025 年 4 月,全球插电式车型注册量较 2024 年同期增长 22%,约达 150 万辆。更值得关注的是,纯电动汽车(BEV)进一步拉开与插电式混合动力(PHEV)的差距:BEV 同比增长 26% 至 100 万辆,而 PHEV 同期增长 15% 至约 50 万辆。 整体来看,插电式车型占 4 月汽车市场总份额的 22%(其中 BEV 单独占比 15%),年初至今累计占比维持在 21%(BEV 占 14%)。4 月 BEV 占插电式车型注册量的 66%,年初至今累计占比同样为 66%。2024 年 BEV 全年占比为 63%,这意味着 2025 年纯电动车型在这一指标上继续保持向好态势。 2025 年,非插电式混合动力车型(HEV)占全球总销量的 14%,这意味着全球汽车总销量中已有超过三分之一(35%)实现了某种形式的电气化。全球汽车市场正坚定地走在电动化之路上。 更重要的是,插电式车型销量持续快速增长(今年增幅达 27%),而内燃机车型(ICE,含 HEV)销量同比下降 4%——2024 年同期已较 2023 年下降 1%。因此,2023 年可视为 ICE 车型的销量峰值年。 预计未来几年这一趋势将持续甚至加速,插电式车型增速将超过市场整体水平,并占据更多市场份额。 回到4 月畅销榜,最大新闻是:比亚迪宋超越特斯拉 Model Y! 在这款美国跨界车连续近三年占据主导地位后,终于有车型成功超越它。颇具戏剧性的是,完成这一突破的竟是另一款 “老将”(指比亚迪宋车型已推出多年)。 尽管4 月登顶,宋系列月交付量 51,550 辆,同比下滑 15% 由于国内市场面临较新的内部竞争(如宋 L、海狮 07,或许还有几款我忘了的车型),这款中国 SUV 的销量在本土市场快速下降,而拯救其表现的是出口市场。在欧盟(超 5,000 辆)、土耳其(3,700 辆)和巴西(3,100 辆)等地,宋系列迎来了 “第二春”。 这就像那些运动员,当达到一定年龄后,离开顶级联赛转投竞争压力较小的联赛,从而得以延续职业生涯数年。 至于Model Y,随着 3 月首批改款车型交付,外界曾预计其销量会有所回升。但 4 月交付量同比下滑 29%,至 50,889 辆。6 月呢?如果这些月份都未见起色,那么…… 奥斯汀(注:特斯拉美国总部所在地),我们遇到问题了。 比亚迪海鸥拿下 4 月销量季军,直接竞争对手吉利星越 L 屈居第四,落后约 1000 辆。此外,若吉利决心加速出口,这款小型掀背车甚至可能跻身榜首!

webs.title: BYD's Q3 battery electric vehicle sales tie Tesla in global market
webs.content: BYD's Q3 battery electric vehicle sales tie Tesla in global market Workers assemble new-energy vehicles (NEVs) at a plant in Southwest China's Chongqing Municipality to fill overseas orders on September 21, 2023. NEV exports totaled 727,000 units in the first eight months of 2023, up 110 percent year-on-year, data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers showed. Photo: VCG Chinese automaker BYD's third-quarter battery electric vehicle (BEV) sales tied Tesla's, reaching 17 percent of the global BEV market, and the company is expected to overtake the US automaker in the fourth quarter to become the global leader, a report by market research organization Counterpoint Research showed. Experts said that with the rise of Chinese automakers like BYD, the global landscape of new-energy vehicle (NEV) sales has changed. Thanks to technological breakthroughs and domestic market support, China's auto industry will maintain growth momentum and further drive the country's exports and domestic consumption, they said. China's Ministry of Public Security said that at the end of September, China's ownership of pure electric vehicles, or BEVs, stood at 14.01 million, or 76.9 percent of the total number of NEVs. BYD said in a statement sent to the Global Times that from January to November of this year, its new-energy passenger car exports exceeded 200,000 units, close to four times the full year of 2022. In recent years, BYD has expanded its overseas passenger car business to more than 50 countries and regions such as Australia, Singapore, Thailand, Japan and Brazil. "The third-quarter achievement of BYD can be attributed to its independence in terms of new-energy core technology advantages such as batteries, motors and electronic controls, which are more cost-effective than Tesla," Zhang Xiang, president of the New Energy Vehicle Technology Research Institute, Jiangxi New Energy Technology Vocational College, told the Global Times on Wednesday. webs.title: GT Voice: Will Chinese car brands break into world’s top 10 sellers?
webs.content: The surge of electric vehicles (EVs) in the global market is an irreversible trend. Tesla's Model Y made history by becoming the first pure electric car to hold the title of the world's best-selling vehicle in 2023, UK-based research firm Jato Dynamics said in a recent report. The report revealed the top 25 best-selling vehicles globally in 2023, with no Chinese car models making the top 10 despite the overall rapid growth of Chinese EV sales. BYD's Qin, ranked 12th, emerged as the best-selling Chinese vehicle, with sales jumping 43 percent year-on-year to 473,000 in 2023. BYD's Song Plus ranked 19th and its Yuan Plus ranked 23rd. These results have garnered a significant amount of attention. However, with Chinese EVs facing intense competition and challenges from Western companies, it begs the question of whether Chinese car brands can make their way into the world's top 10 best-sellers amid ongoing geopolitical and trade tensions. Chinese auto brands have made significant advancements in recent years in terms of quality, design and technology, among other factors. Particularly in the new-energy vehicle sector, Chinese brands have demonstrated impressive growth and emerged as competitive players in the global market. This can be seen in the success of brands like BYD and NIO, which have established a strong presence in both domestic and international markets through continuous technological innovation and strategic market expansion efforts. However, simply achieving success in the domestic market is not sufficient for global success. When it comes to a global market presence, Chinese car brands still have considerable ground to cover in enhancing their influence and competitiveness. There are still considerable gaps between Chinese brands and internationally renowned brands in aspects such as brand recognition, internationalization strategies, technological innovation capabilities and marketing. The fast-rising Chinese automotive brand BYD continued its play for global new energy vehicle (NEV) leadership in Q2 2024. The automaker reported a net income of CN$9.06bn (US$1.28bn) for the quarter, its second highest on record behind CN$10.4bn in Q3 2023. webs.title: Tesla overtaken by BYD in global EV sales in 2025
webs.content: SAN FRANCISCO -- US electric automaker Tesla said Friday that its global vehicle deliveries in 2025 fell by around 8.6 percent year on year, marking the first time the company has been overtaken in annual electric vehicle sales by China's automaker BYD. Tesla produced 1.655 million electric vehicles in 2025 and delivered 1.636 million, lower than the 1.773 million vehicles produced and 1.789 million delivered in 2024, according to company data. The impact on sales became most pronounced after tax credits that had encouraged US consumers to purchase electric vehicles were eliminated in September 2025. In the fourth quarter of 2025, Tesla produced 434,358 vehicles and delivered 418,227, down from 459,445 produced and 495,570 delivered in the same period a year earlier. Fourth-quarter deliveries fell around 16 percent year on year. BYD said Thursday that its global electric vehicle sales reached 2.257 million in 2025, up 27.86 percent from a year earlier, with a growing share of sales coming from markets outside China, including Asia, Europe and Latin America. Tesla remains the largest electric vehicle manufacturer in the United States, accounting for about 45 percent of the domestic EV market. However, its declining sales suggest a broader slowdown in the US electric vehicle market. Data from automotive research firm Cox Automotive showed that US electric vehicle sales across all brands plunged by over 40 percent year on year in November 2025. Industry analysts expect overall US electric vehicle sales to remain weak in 2026.

webs.title: EV Slowdown Countered by Energy Storage Boom
webs.content: EV Slowdown Countered by Energy Storage Boom Battery manufacturers are having hard times this year. LG Energy Solutions and Samsung SDI recently posted falling quarterly revenues and profits, while Panasonic’s battery division missed its targets. Even the world’s largest battery maker, CATL, reported its first drop in quarterly profit earlier this year. Most of this has been caused by a slowdown in the growth rate for electric-vehicle sales, leading to lower-than-expected battery volumes, intense competition andprice cutsto defend market share. EVs are the biggest source of demand for batteries, and the industry’sovercapacity issueisn’t going anywhere anytime soon. Nameplate battery manufacturing capacity just in China alone reached 2.2 terawatt-hours at the end of 2023, almost double the 1.2 TWh of global demand that BNEF is expecting for 2024. Despite that, it’s worth keeping an eye on the stationary storage market, which has boomed the last two years. BloombergNEF team of analysts who follow the space are expecting this to continue, with energy storage installations rising 61% this year. Prices for turnkey energy storage systems are down 43% from a year ago, and that’s leading to a big increase in deployments. As with many of these topics, the most interesting data is coming out of China, where energy storage applications overtook consumer electronics as the second-largest application for battery production last year. Global energy storage installations — including residential, commercial and utility scale — account for a growing share of total battery demand, rising from 6% in 2020 to an expected 13% this year. Put another way, the ratio of EV battery demand to stationary battery demand has fallen from 15-to-1 to 6-to-1 over the last four years. That means stationary storage is now a material part of global battery demand and is growing much faster than the EV segment. webs.title: China's EV manufacturing powers global industry chain
webs.content: This photo taken on July 3, 2023 shows China's 20 millionth new energy vehicle (NEV) produced by GAC Aion New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd. in Guangzhou, south China's Guangdong Province. [Photo/Xinhua] In an automotive workshop spanning an area equivalent to 16 soccer fields in Hefei, a city in east China's Anhui Province, more than 800 robots are working collaboratively to assemble six different models of new energy vehicles (NEVs). This workshop is part of Volkswagen's new NEV production facility, designed to address the swiftly increasing demand in the country while facing formidable local competition. While Chinese electric car manufacturers and suppliers made a strong presence at the bustling showrooms of this year's International Motor Show (IAA) in Munich, Germany, Volkswagen reiterated its commitment to establishing a localized supply chain in the Chinese market. The German auto giant will forge ahead with an "in China for China" strategy with homegrown partners, Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume noted in his speech at the IAA. The global market for NEVs is exploding, with multiple Chinese manufacturers along the industrial chain emerging as star enterprises. The real story behind the prosperous EV sector is more vibrant than China's ascent in the electric vehicle industry. Technology, capital and markets from around the world, including China, are merging to form a larger industrial landscape that benefits countries transitioning to eco-friendly transportation. Rather than pursuing a "Chinese-market-for-foreign-technology" approach in the era of traditional fuel vehicles, XPENG has leveraged its proprietary expertise in NEV software. webs.title: China's new-energy sector draws interest of global investors
webs.content: In Shanghai, the electric carmaker has already operated a gigafactory, which delivered 947,000 vehicles in 2023, an increase of 33 percent from the previous year. Experts said China's fast-growing green technologies and its thriving new-energy market have heightened the country's magnetism for foreign investors, particularly auto firms keen on turbocharging the electrification trend. Last month, BMW announced an additional investment of 20 billion yuan (about 2.8 billion U.S. dollars) in its production base in Shenyang to facilitate the production of its Neue Klasse EV-only lineup. The latest funding initiative signals the company's "strong commitment to the Chinese market" and shows a "sign of confidence in future prospects," according to the German auto giant. Also in April, Volkswagen Group announced an investment of 2.5 billion euros (about 2.68 billion U.S. dollars) in the expansion of its innovation hub in Hefei, the capital of east China's Anhui Province, to increase its pace of innovation in China. The investment will be used to step up innovation and accelerate the production of two Volkswagen-brand smart electric vehicles, which are under joint development with Chinese manufacturer Xpeng. More than 30 all-electric models of all its brands will be on offer in China alone by 2030, according to the German carmaker. "We are fully committed to China. A strong position in China is equal to a strong position in the global automotive market," Volkswagen Group CEO Oliver Blume said, adding that no other region in the world has seen the transformation of the automotive industry as fast-paced as China.

webs.title: 特斯拉第一,比亚迪第二!全球最畅销电动车榜单出炉
webs.content: 特斯拉第一,比亚迪第二!全球最畅销电动车榜单出炉 CleanTechnica日前发布了全球最畅销的20款电车(含插混)报告,相比去年8月,今年8月全球电车注册量激增45%,插电混动车型占了整个汽车市场的18%,纯电占了13%。 其中今年前8个月,特斯拉Model Y(参数|询价|图片)卖得最好,其次是比亚迪宋车系,再往后则是Model 3、秦PLUS等等。 (2023前8个月数据) 马斯克在推特也针对这份数据进行了评论,表示:“根据我们的经验,中国汽车制造商是最具竞争力的。” 看回国内,2023上半年新能源车销量排行榜(品牌)当中比亚迪第一,特斯拉第二,AION第三,值得一提的是CleanTechnica的榜单也有AION、理想 、长安等自主品牌的身影。 我国电动车起步比较早,所以相关产业配套更完善,接下来估计还会有一大堆国产车刷国外的榜单。

webs.title: 全球新能源车销量榜:比亚迪第一,特斯拉第二,第三出乎意料
webs.content: 全球新能源车品牌销量榜 比亚迪特斯拉遥遥领先 2023 Q1,比亚迪和特斯拉仍然稳居品牌榜冠亚军,两家公司共同占据了全球新能源车市场的三分之一以上市场份额。而比亚迪上升至第一名,其市场份额增长(去年同期为15.5%,现在为20.4%)令人印象深刻,已经领先于第二名的特斯拉。宝马则排在第3位,而在其下方,大众汽车超越了放缓的五菱并回到了第4位。 广汽和长安也实现崛起,分别从第12位上升到第6位,从第14位上升到第9位。

webs.title: 2023年一季度全球电动车销量榜出炉
webs.content: Q1全球Top 20电动车榜单:特斯拉Model Y一骑绝尘 得益于季度末的销量冲刺,特斯拉Model Y在3月份创下了145,306辆的新销量纪录,甚至击败丰田卡罗拉和RAV4等车型,成为当月全球最畅销的汽车(包括所有动力系统)。这也使其一季度的全球累计销量达到近28万辆,独占鳌头,差不多是第二名比亚迪宋(包括纯电动和插混)的两倍。 相比之下,特斯拉旗下另一款车型Model 3尽管大幅降价,但销量同比仅增长4%,这也说明这款车的销量目前正处于成熟阶段,只有车辆大幅更新才能再次提振销量。而Model S/X尽管也从大幅降价中受益,但这两款车型今年一季度的销量却仍然下降27%。 作为对比,比亚迪秦Plus得益于最近的降价,排名攀升至第五位。其他名次有所攀升的车型还包括广汽Aion S,超越比亚迪汉来到了第8名;大众ID.4也击败比亚迪唐来到第10位。 乍一看,比亚迪旗下几款旗舰车型似乎正在失去优势,但腾势D9车型却正在崛起,该款车一举跃升四位来到目前的第14名,一季度销量接近2.5万辆,意味着年销量将超过10万辆,开始接近丰田Alphard/Sienna 的销量水平。腾势D9之下,长安Lumin也攀升了两名来到第15名。 就传统车企的电动车型来看,大众ID.3重新跻身榜单并排在第16名,奥迪Q4 e-tron首次跻身全球Top 20电动车榜单并排在第18名。另外,现代Ioniq 5的名次攀升2名来到第17名。这意味着前20名中有5款传统OEM的车型,其中3款来自大众汽车集团。未来在纯电动汽车市场,传统OEM是否能重新夺回畅销地位? Q1全球Top 20电动车品牌榜:比亚迪较特斯拉略胜一筹 3月份,特斯拉在季度末的冲刺使其销量达到新高,为207,655辆,而比亚迪当月销量未能突破20万辆;不过就一季度的累计销量来看,比亚迪仍然略胜一筹,目前仍然领先特斯拉10万辆左右,预计未来几个月将继续保持领先态势。 当前,比亚迪和特斯拉合计占据全球电动汽车市场逾三分之一的份额。在这两品牌之下,宝马第3名的位置依然稳固,而大众超越放缓的上汽通用五菱重新回到第4名。

webs.title: 比亚迪追平特斯拉有望成为全球纯电销冠 前三名品牌占据42%市场份额
webs.content: 全球市场调查机构Counterpoint Research近期发布的报告显示,2023年第三季度,全球纯电动汽车销量同比增长29%,中国占据58%的市场份额,依然是全球最大的纯电汽车市场。 报告指出,由于价格战等因素导致国内市场增长放缓,而其他国家纯电市场大幅增长,第三季度中国纯电动汽车销量增长11%,低于全球平均水平。但中国汽车品牌在海外市场方面获得大幅增长,同比提升4倍至13万辆。 目前,特斯拉、比亚迪和大众是全球最畅销的纯电汽车品牌,三家品牌合计的市场份额达到42%。 值得注意的是,比亚迪纯电动汽车市场份额(不包括腾势)已追上特斯拉,两者三季度市场份额均为17%。从数据来看,2023年第三季度,特斯拉共交付超43.5万辆,比亚迪纯电汽车共交付43.16万辆,仅仅比特斯拉低了3500辆左右,几乎持平。 实际上,特斯拉三季度交付量环比下滑6.7%,而比亚迪纯电车型交付量则环比提升22.5%。按此趋势来看,尽管Model 3换新后特斯拉10月、11月在华交付量拉升,比亚迪依然有望在四季度超越特斯拉,成为全球纯电销冠。 从车型来看,全球最受欢迎的车型分别为特斯拉Model Y、Model 3,和比亚迪的元Plus、海豚和海鸥。 该机构的高级分析师苏曼·曼达尔(Soumen Mandal)表示,中国仍占全球纯电动汽车市场58%的市场份额,美国为12%,德国是第三大纯电动汽车市场,年增长率超过60%。 另外,由于价格便宜和政策推动,印度和东南亚等地区的纯电动汽车渗透率也在逐步提升。 2023年美国纯电动车市场大幅扩张,第三季度销量同比增长63%,但仍低于汽车制造商们的预期。包括福特、通用在内的部分汽车制造商们选择削减电动汽车相关费用,推迟电动化转型。 该机构研究总监杰夫·菲尔德哈克(Jeff Fieldhack)认为,2023年全球纯电动汽车销量预计近千万辆,其中美国市场将同比增长超过50%。此外,电动汽车电池原材料成本的降低,将有助于汽车价格的下降。

webs.title: 中国车企出海新机遇丨2030年有望占全球市场33%份额
webs.content: 日前,咨询公司艾睿铂(AlixPartners)的一份报告显示,到2030年,中国汽车品牌在全球的市场份额预计将达到33%,预计大部分增长将来自中国以外的市场,今年中国车企在全球的市场份额预计为21%。 艾睿铂预计,到2030年,中国品牌汽车在中国以外地区的销量将从今年的300万辆增长到900万辆。而中国品牌汽车在中国的市场份额也将从59%增长到72%。 分析指出,近年来中国汽车市场份额很大部分已经被比亚迪、吉利和蔚来等本土品牌所占据。 知名汽车行业分析师张翔向财经网汽车表示,国内自主品牌的崛起和新势力品牌的强势表现,特别是当它们的产品价格迈入30万元以上的高端市场时,不仅市场表现不俗,而且给传统高端品牌带来了不小的冲击。 中国市场自主品牌强势崛起 从国内市场来看,中国品牌乘用车市场占有率正持续攀升。据工业和信息化部数据统计,2023年累计销售1459.6万辆,同比增长24.1%,年度市场份额达到56%,比上年上升6.1个百分点。 2023年新能源汽车产销分别完成958.7万辆和949.5万辆,同比分别增长35.8%和37.9%。其中,中国品牌新能源乘用车市场份额更是达到80.6%。 中国汽车工业协会副秘书长陈士华接受媒体采访时表示,近两年中国品牌乘用车市占率不断提升,一方面是我们的主流车企在电动化转型方面快于合资品牌;另一方面,表现亮眼的出口市场以中国品牌为主。 据央视新闻,中国汽车工业协会公布的数据还显示,从2021年开始,三年来,中国品牌乘用车市场占有率持续攀升。 2021年,中国品牌乘用车销量954.3万辆,市场份额44.4%;2022年,中国品牌乘用车销量1176.6万辆,市场份额49.9%;2023年,中国品牌乘用车销量1459.6万辆,市场份额56%。 今年前4个月,中国品牌乘用车销量预计将突破460万辆,市场份额有望达到60%。 艾睿铂公司全球汽车和工业实践联合负责人韦克菲尔德指出:“中国是汽车行业的新颠覆者,能够制造出更快上市、更便宜、技术更先进且设计更高效的汽车。传统的原始设备制造商需要的不仅仅是调整路线。” 分析还指出,中国品牌在车辆开发时间和成本方面具有显著优势。中国电动汽车制造商创造新产品的时间仅为40个月,非中国品牌则需要两倍的时间。此外,中国品牌平均上市时间为1.6年,比非中国品牌快两年至三年。 韦克菲尔德还强调,到2030年,新能源汽车将占据全球车辆销售的近一半,中国品牌将在国际市场上占据三分之一的份额。 据新华社,2023年以来,我国新能源汽车出口一直保持高位增长,增速超过传统燃油车,每4辆出口汽车中就有近1辆汽车来自新能源汽车。

webs.title: BYD overtakes Tesla for the first time to lead global EV sales
webs.content: BYD overtakes Tesla for the first time to lead global EV sales On January 2, U.S. electric vehicle maker Tesla announced that it delivered 1.636 million vehicles worldwide in 2025, representing a year-on-year decline of approximately 8.6 percent. This marks the first time in Tesla's history that its annual global EV sales have been surpassed by Chinese automaker BYD. Tesla reported that it delivered 418,000 vehicles in the fourth quarter of 2025, reflecting a year-on-year decline of 15.6 percent and falling short of analysts' expectations of around 434,000. Thus, its total deliveries for the entire year fell to 1.636 million, a decrease from 1.79 million in 2024, and also lower than the market expectation of about 1.65 million. China's automotive giant BYD revealed on January 1 that its total new vehicle sales in 2025 exceeded 4.6 million units, representing a year-on-year increase of about 8 percent. Meanwhile, its new pure EV sales surpassed 2.25 million units, reflecting a growth of around 28 percent. This marks the first time BYD has topped the global pure EV sales leader board. (Chinese Source: CCTV News Translator: Zhang Yahan Proofreader: Ding Lan and Zhao Hanqing)

webs.title: BYD Leads Tesla by 388,000 Units in the First Three Quarters of 2025, Global Electric Vehicle Sales Champion May Be Settled
webs.content: BYD Leads Tesla by 388,000 Units in the First Three Quarters of 2025, Global Electric Vehicle Sales Champion May Be Settled In the third quarter of 2025, BYD once again led Tesla in the global pure electric vehicle market. According to the official production and sales reports and Tesla's third-quarter report, BYD's sales of pure electric models reached 582,522 units in the third quarter, while Tesla's deliveries were 497,099 units, giving BYD a quarterly lead of 85,423 units. This means that BYD has maintained its lead over Tesla in global pure electric sales for four consecutive quarters, from the fourth quarter of 2024 to the third quarter of 2025, solidifying its leading position in the global electric vehicle market. In the first three quarters of 2025, BYD's overall sales of new energy vehicles (NEVs) reached 3.26 million units, with pure electric models contributing the core share, accounting for 49.26% with nearly 1.606 million units sold. Recently, Bloomberg analysts predicted that BYD will surpass Tesla this year by a significant margin. BYD is expected to deliver about 2.17 million pure electric vehicles, while the average estimate for Tesla is 1.61 million units. webs.content: It’s been a big year for electric vehicles. Sales are rising, battery prices are dropping, and BloombergNEF has pushed up its sales forecast thanks to huge sales in China, South Korea and North America. On the flip side, legacy automakers are backing away from their EV targets, and the US election is sending a president witha litany of complaintsabout clean cars back to the White House. As the year draws to a close, here are 10 key trends that helped shape the EV world in 2024 – and could pave the industry’s way going forward. Tesla shifts lanes From the cancellation of a $25,000 car to the turn toward autonomous robotaxis and artificial intelligence, the world’s biggest manufacturer of battery-electric cars has been making waves with its abrupt shifts in direction. Tesla’s actions often influence investors and outside stakeholders, so moving away from their goal of cheaper vehicles is a big deal, especially since most Teslas remain out of reach for many American consumers. The Cybertruck did better than naysayers expected, but does it have legs going into 2025? CEO Elon Musk mentioned in Tesla’s 3Q 2024 earnings call that cheaper Tesla vehicles may be delivered next year, but there are no details. In a year when many automakers are stepping back from their EV targets, BYDupped its targetto 4 million car sales this year — and is on track to meet that goal. BYD’s 2024 sales have been boosted by plug-in hybrids and extended-range EVs.
